Gemini Cuộc trò chuyện mới Tìm kiếm trong các cuộc trò chuyện Thư viện Sổ ghi chú mới Tạo Game 2D Bắn Zombie Bằng Python Khắc phục lỗi UnityPackageManager.exe Unity 6.5 Đã Cài Xong Khắc phục iPhone bị treo táo Giải bài tập hình học tam giác ABC Yêu cầu và tạo ảnh Trò chuyện với Gemini không ý tui là bạn lấy đò họa zombie ở code này gắn lên code nãy bạn vừa đưa cho tui á Ồ, em hiểu rồi! Em đã lấy đúng cách vẽ đồ họa Zombie từ đoạn code thứ 2 (có vai áo rộng, 2 cánh tay vươn ra, bàn tay máu, đầu và mắt sáng theo màu chủng loại) để gắn đè vào phần vẽ Zombie của bộ code đầy đủ menu/shop trước đó. Dưới đây là toàn bộ mã nguồn Pygame hoàn chỉnh đã được hợp nhất thành công: Python import pygame import random import math pygame.init() # Cấu hình màn hình WIDTH, HEIGHT = 900, 650 screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT)) pygame.display.set_caption("2D Tank vs Zombies - Ultimate Edition") clock = pygame.time.Clock() # Bảng màu sắc đồ họa cao cấp WHITE = (255, 255, 255) BLACK = (10, 10, 15) RED = (255, 75, 75) DARK_RED = (120, 10, 10) GREEN = (45, 240, 120) YELLOW = (255, 220, 50) GRAY = (55, 55, 70) BLUE = (60, 180, 255) ORANGE = (255, 130, 20) CYAN = (0, 245, 245) GOLD = (255, 210, 60) PURPLE = (180, 80, 255) font = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 16, bold=True) font_medium = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 20, bold=True) font_large = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 30, bold=True) font_title = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 52, bold=True) # Biến lưu tiền và cấp độ nâng cấp trong Shop player_gold = 500 shop_upgrades = { "maxhp": 0, "dmg": 0, "spd": 0, "multishot": 0, "pierce": 0, "rate": 0, "vampire": 0, "explosive": 0, "nova": 0 } # Quản lý Đợt (Wave) current_wave = 1 zombies_to_spawn = 20 zombies_spawned_count = 0 spawn_timer = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False # Khởi tạo chi tiết nền chiến trường random.seed(100) BG_DECORATIONS = [] for _ in range(35): BG_DECORATIONS.append({ "type": random.choice(["crater", "rock", "crack", "oil_pool"]), "x": random.randint(50, WIDTH - 50), "y": random.randint(50, HEIGHT - 50), "size": random.randint(20, 55) }) random.seed() def draw_battlefield_background(surface): surface.fill((20, 20, 28)) for deco in BG_DECORATIONS: if deco["type"] == "crater": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (14, 14, 20), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, (28, 28, 38), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"], 2) elif deco["type"] == "oil_pool": oil_surf = pygame.Surface((deco["size"]*2, deco["size"]), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(oil_surf, (10, 10, 15, 120), (0, 0, deco["size"]*2, deco["size"])) surface.blit(oil_surf, (deco["x"] - deco["size"], deco["y"] - deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "rock": pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (32, 32, 44), (deco["x"] - deco["size"]//2, deco["y"] - deco["size"]//4, deco["size"], deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "crack": pygame.draw.line(surface, (15, 15, 22), (deco["x"] - 12, deco["y"]), (deco["x"] + 18, deco["y"] + 14), 2) def draw_coin_icon(surface, x, y, radius=10): pygame.draw.circle(surface, (180, 120, 10), (x + 1, y + 2), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, GOLD, (x, y), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (x, y), radius - 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (x - 3, y - 3), 2) def draw_super_polished_icon(surface, x, y, skill_id, is_hovered): size = 42 offset = -2 if is_hovered else 0 nx, ny = x + offset, y + offset if is_hovered: glow_surf = pygame.Surface((size + 16, size + 16), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.rect(glow_surf, (255, 215, 0, 100), (0, 0, size + 16, size + 16), border_radius=12) surface.blit(glow_surf, (nx - 8, ny - 8)) pygame.draw.rect(surface, (12, 12, 18), (nx + 2, ny + 4, size, size), border_radius=10) bg_color = (70, 70, 100) if is_hovered else (42, 42, 60) pygame.draw.rect(surface, bg_color, (nx, ny, size, size), border_radius=10) border_col = GOLD if is_hovered else (130, 130, 160) pygame.draw.rect(surface, border_col, (nx, ny, size, size), 2, border_radius=10) cx, cy = nx + size // 2, ny + size // 2 if skill_id == "maxhp": pygame.draw.polygon(surface, BLUE, [(cx, cy - 12), (cx + 10, cy - 6), (cx + 10, cy + 4), (cx, cy + 12), (cx - 10, cy + 4), (cx - 10, cy - 6)]) elif skill_id == "dmg": pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx - 12, cy + 12), (cx + 10, cy - 10), 4) pygame.draw.rect(surface, RED, (cx - 14, cy + 6, 7, 7)) elif skill_id == "spd": pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx - 12, cy - 6), (cx + 8, cy - 6), 4) pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx - 8, cy), (cx + 12, cy), 4) elif skill_id == "multishot": pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (cx - 6, cy), 4) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (cx + 6, cy - 6), 4) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (cx + 6, cy + 6), 4) elif skill_id == "pierce": pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx - 12, cy), (cx + 12, cy), 5) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, CYAN, [(cx + 12, cy - 6), (cx + 16, cy), (cx + 12, cy + 6)]) elif skill_id == "rate": pygame.draw.arc(surface, GREEN, (cx - 10, cy - 10, 20, 20), 0, 3.14, 3) pygame.draw.line(surface, GREEN, (cx, cy), (cx + 6, cy - 6), 3) elif skill_id == "vampire": pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx, cy), 8) pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx - 5, cy), (cx + 5, cy), 3) elif skill_id == "explosive": pygame.draw.circle(surface, ORANGE, (cx, cy), 9) elif skill_id == "nova": pygame.draw.circle(surface, PURPLE, (cx, cy), 10, 3) UPGRADE_POOL = [ {"id": "multishot", "text": "Pháo Đa Nòng (+1 Đạn)"}, {"id": "pierce", "text": "Đạn Xuyên Thấu (+1 Quái)"}, {"id": "explosive", "text": "Đạn Pháo Nổ Diện Rộng"}, {"id": "vampire", "text": "Hút Máu Khi Diệt Quái"}, {"id": "nova", "text": "Sóng Nổ Quét Bản Đồ"}, {"id": "dmg", "text": "+20% Sát Thương Pháo"}, {"id": "spd", "text": "+15% Tốc Độ Động Cơ"}, {"id": "rate", "text": "+20% Tốc Độ Bắn"}, {"id": "maxhp", "text": "+25% Máu Tối Đa"} ] class Coin: def __init__(self, x, y, value): self.x, self.y = x, y self.value = value self.radius = 8 def draw(self): shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((18, 12), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(shadow_surf, (0, 0, 0, 100), (0, 0, 18, 12)) screen.blit(shadow_surf, (int(self.x) - 9, int(self.y) - 3)) draw_coin_icon(screen, int(self.x), int(self.y), self.radius) class Explosion: def __init__(self, x, y, radius): self.x, self.y = x, y self.max_radius = radius self.current_radius = 6 self.alpha = 255 def update(self): self.current_radius += 5 self.alpha -= 18 return self.alpha <= 0 or self.current_radius >= self.max_radius def draw(self): surf = pygame.Surface((self.max_radius * 2, self.max_radius * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA) color = (255, 140, 20, max(0, self.alpha)) core_color = (255, 240, 150, max(0, self.alpha)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, core_color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius * 0.4)) screen.blit(surf, (self.x - self.max_radius, self.y - self.max_radius)) class TankPlayer: def __init__(self): self.reset() def reset(self): self.x, self.y = WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2 self.speed = 3.5 + (shop_upgrades["spd"] * 0.4) self.max_hp = 120 + (shop_upgrades["maxhp"] * 30) self.hp = self.max_hp self.damage = 30 + (shop_upgrades["dmg"] * 8) self.level = 1 self.exp = 0 self.exp_to_next_level = 100 self.fire_rate = max(100, 300 - (shop_upgrades["rate"] * 30)) self.last_shot = 0 self.bullet_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["multishot"] self.pierce_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["pierce"] self.explosive_bullets = shop_upgrades["explosive"] > 0 self.vampirism = shop_upgrades["vampire"] * 2 def draw(self): px, py = int(self.x), int(self.y) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() gun_angle = math.atan2(my - py, mx - px) shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((50, 40), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(shadow_surf, (0, 0, 0, 140), (0, 0, 50, 40)) screen.blit(shadow_surf, (px - 25, py - 14)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (35, 55, 30), (px - 20, py - 16, 40, 32), border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (55, 90, 45), (px - 17, py - 13, 34, 26), border_radius=6) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (px - 22, py - 18, 8, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (px + 14, py - 18, 8, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, (40, 65, 30), (px, py), 13) pygame.draw.circle(screen, (60, 95, 45), (px, py), 10) ex_x, ex_y = px + math.cos(gun_angle) * 28, py + math.sin(gun_angle) * 28 pygame.draw.line(screen, (20, 20, 25), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 8) pygame.draw.line(screen, (45, 45, 55), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 4) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (self.x - 24, self.y - 50, 48, 8), border_radius=3) hp_width = max(0, 44 * (self.hp / self.max_hp)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (self.x - 22, self.y - 48, hp_width, 4), border_radius=2) def move(self, keys): dx, dy = 0, 0 if keys[pygame.K_w] and self.y > 30: dy -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_s] and self.y < HEIGHT - 30: dy += 1 if keys[pygame.K_a] and self.x > 30: dx -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_d] and self.x < WIDTH - 30: dx += 1 if dx != 0 or dy != 0: length = math.hypot(dx, dy) self.x += (dx / length) * self.speed self.y += (dy / length) * self.speed def add_exp(self, amount): self.exp += amount leveled_up = False while self.exp >= self.exp_to_next_level: self.exp -= self.exp_to_next_level self.level += 1 self.exp_to_next_level = self.level * 100 leveled_up = True return leveled_up class Bullet: def __init__(self, x, y, angle_rad, damage, pierce, is_explosive): self.x, self.y = x, y self.damage = damage self.speed = 13 self.dx = math.cos(angle_rad) * self.speed self.dy = math.sin(angle_rad) * self.speed self.pierce = pierce self.is_explosive = is_explosive def update(self): self.x += self.dx self.y += self.dy def draw(self): color = ORANGE if self.is_explosive else YELLOW pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, (int(self.x), int(self.y)), 5) # Lớp Zombie dùng chính xác đồ họa vẽ chi tiết từ code 2 class Zombie: def __init__(self, is_boss=False, tier=1): side = random.choice(['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']) if side == 'top': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), -45 elif side == 'bottom': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), HEIGHT + 45 elif side == 'left': self.x, self.y = -45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) else: self.x, self.y = WIDTH + 45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) self.is_boss = is_boss self.tier = tier if is_boss: self.type = "TANK" self.radius, self.speed, self.hp = 28, 1.2 + (tier * 0.1), 850 + (tier * 220) self.max_hp = self.hp self.skin_color = (40, 70, 50) # Xanh thẫm độc hại self.shirt_color = (30, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 1000, 150 else: self.type = "NORMAL" if tier == 1 else "FAST" self.radius = 16 if tier == 1 else 13 self.speed = random.uniform(1.3, 1.8) + (tier - 1) * 0.2 self.hp = self.max_hp = 50 + (tier - 1) * 35 self.skin_color = (80, 130, 70) if tier == 1 else (130, 60, 50) self.shirt_color = (60, 60, 90) if tier == 1 else (100, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 15 + (tier - 1) * 5, 10 + (tier - 1) * 5 def update(self, px, py): angle = math.atan2(py - self.y, px - self.x) self.x += math.cos(angle) * self.speed self.y += math.sin(angle) * self.speed def draw(self, px, py): ix, iy = int(self.x), int(self.y) angle = math.atan2(py - iy, px - ix) cos_a = math.cos(angle) sin_a = math.sin(angle) # 1. Hai vai áo rộng shoulder_w = self.radius * 1.1 p1_x = ix + cos_a * 2 - sin_a * shoulder_w p1_y = iy + sin_a * 2 + cos_a * shoulder_w p2_x = ix + cos_a * 2 + sin_a * shoulder_w p2_y = iy + sin_a * 2 - cos_a * shoulder_w pygame.draw.line(screen, self.shirt_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (p2_x, p2_y), int(self.radius * 0.8)) # 2. Hai cánh tay vươn về phía trước arm_len = self.radius * 1.5 arm1_x = p1_x + cos_a * arm_len arm1_y = p1_y + sin_a * arm_len arm2_x = p2_x + cos_a * arm_len arm2_y = p2_y + sin_a * arm_len pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (arm1_x, arm1_y), 4) pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p2_x, p2_y), (arm2_x, arm2_y), 4) # Bàn tay máu pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm1_x), int(arm1_y)), 3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm2_x), int(arm2_y)), 3) # 3. Cái đầu Zombie head_x = ix + cos_a * 4 head_y = iy + sin_a * 4 pygame.draw.circle(screen, self.skin_color, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75)) pygame.draw.circle(screen, BLACK, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75), 2) # 4. Mắt phát sáng dữ tợn eye1_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 - sin_a * 5 eye1_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 + cos_a * 5 eye2_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 + sin_a * 5 eye2_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 - cos_a * 5 pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye1_x), int(eye1_y)), 2) pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye2_x), int(eye2_y)), 2) # Thanh máu Zombie if self.hp < self.max_hp: bar_w = self.radius * 2.2 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, bar_w, 4)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, max(0, bar_w * (self.hp / self.max_hp)), 4)) def apply_upgrade(player, upgrade_id, zombies, explosions): if upgrade_id == "multishot": player.bullet_count = min(5, player.bullet_count + 1) elif upgrade_id == "pierce": player.pierce_count += 1 elif upgrade_id == "explosive": player.explosive_bullets = True elif upgrade_id == "vampire": player.vampirism += 2 elif upgrade_id == "nova": explosions.append(Explosion(player.x, player.y, 220)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - player.x, z.y - player.y) < 220: z.hp -= 70 elif upgrade_id == "dmg": player.damage *= 1.2 elif upgrade_id == "spd": player.speed *= 1.15 elif upgrade_id == "rate": player.fire_rate = max(70, player.fire_rate * 0.8) elif upgrade_id == "maxhp": player.max_hp *= 1.25 player.hp += player.max_hp * 0.25 player = TankPlayer() bullets, zombies, explosions, coins = [], [], [], [] game_state = "MENU" current_choices = [] def reset_game(): global bullets, zombies, explosions, coins, spawn_timer, game_state, current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave player.reset() bullets.clear(); zombies.clear(); explosions.clear(); coins.clear() current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave = 1, 20, 0, False game_state = "PLAYING" running = True while running: clock.tick(60) current_time = pygame.time.get_ticks() for event in pygame.event.get(): if event.type == pygame.QUIT: running = False if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() if game_state == "MENU": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 20, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 80, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "SHOP" elif game_state == "SHOP": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 55, 220, 40).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" shop_items_data = [ ("maxhp", 50), ("dmg", 70), ("spd", 60), ("multishot", 120), ("pierce", 90), ("rate", 80), ("vampire", 150), ("explosive", 200), ("nova", 250) ] col_width, row_height = 420, 50 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - 430, WIDTH // 2 + 10, 90 for i, (item_id, base_cost) in enumerate(shop_items_data): c = 0 if i < 5 else 1 r = i if c == 0 else i - 5 bx = start_x1 if c == 0 else start_x2 by = start_y + r * row_height if i == 8: bx, by = WIDTH // 2 - col_width // 2, start_y + 5 * row_height if pygame.Rect(bx, by, col_width, 44).collidepoint(mx, my): cost = base_cost + (shop_upgrades[item_id] * 30) if player_gold >= cost: player_gold -= cost shop_upgrades[item_id] += 1 player.reset() elif game_state == "LEVEL_UP": for i in range(len(current_choices)): if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 200, 180 + i * 85, 400, 65).collidepoint(mx, my): apply_upgrade(player, current_choices[i]["id"], zombies, explosions) game_state = "PLAYING" break elif game_state == "GAME_OVER": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 10, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 70, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" keys = pygame.key.get_pressed() if game_state == "PLAYING": player.move(keys) if pygame.mouse.get_pressed()[0] and current_time - player.last_shot > player.fire_rate: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() base_angle = math.atan2(my - player.y, mx - player.x) spread, num_bullets = 0.15, player.bullet_count start_angle = base_angle - (spread * (num_bullets - 1) / 2) for i in range(num_bullets): bullets.append(Bullet(player.x, player.y, start_angle + (spread * i), player.damage, player.pierce_count, player.explosive_bullets)) player.last_shot = current_time if zombies_spawned_count < zombies_to_spawn: spawn_timer += 1 if spawn_timer >= 30: tier = (current_wave - 1) // 10 + 1 zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=False, tier=tier)) zombies_spawned_count += 1 spawn_timer = 0 elif current_wave % 10 == 0 and not boss_spawned_in_wave: zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=True, tier=current_wave // 10)) boss_spawned_in_wave = True elif zombies_spawned_count >= zombies_to_spawn and len(zombies) == 0: current_wave += 1 zombies_to_spawn = current_wave * 20 zombies_spawned_count = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False for bullet in bullets[:]: bullet.update() if not (0 <= bullet.x <= WIDTH and 0 <= bullet.y <= HEIGHT): bullets.remove(bullet) for exp in explosions[:]: if exp.update(): explosions.remove(exp) for coin in coins[:]: if math.hypot(coin.x - player.x, coin.y - player.y) < 25: player_gold += coin.value coins.remove(coin) for zombie in zombies[:]: zombie.update(player.x, player.y) if math.hypot(zombie.x - player.x, zombie.y - player.y) < zombie.radius + 16: player.hp -= 0.5 if player.hp <= 0: game_state = "GAME_OVER" for bullet in bullets[:]: if math.hypot(zombie.x - bullet.x, zombie.y - bullet.y) < zombie.radius + 4: zombie.hp -= bullet.damage if bullet.is_explosive: explosions.append(Explosion(bullet.x, bullet.y, 85)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - bullet.x, z.y - bullet.y) < 85: z.hp -= bullet.damage * 0.5 bullet.pierce -= 1 if bullet.pierce <= 0 and bullet in bullets: bullets.remove(bullet) if zombie.hp <= 0: coins.append(Coin(zombie.x, zombie.y, zombie.gold_drop)) if player.vampirism > 0: player.hp = min(player.max_hp, player.hp + player.vampirism) zombies.remove(zombie) if player.add_exp(zombie.exp_reward): game_state = "LEVEL_UP" current_choices = random.sample(UPGRADE_POOL, 3) break draw_battlefield_background(screen) if game_state == "MENU": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((10, 10, 20, 180)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) title_txt = font_title.render("TANK VS ZOMBIES", True, GREEN) screen.blit(title_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - title_txt.get_width() // 2, 120)) draw_coin_icon(screen, WIDTH - 75, 25, 12) screen.blit(font.render(f"{player_gold}", True, GOLD), (WIDTH - 55, 15)) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() btn_start = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 20, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, btn_start, border_radius=12) txt_s = font.render("BẮT ĐẦU CHƠI", True, BLACK) screen.blit(txt_s, (btn_start.x + (btn_start.width - txt_s.get_width()) // 2, btn_start.y + 14)) btn_shop = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 80, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GOLD, btn_shop, border_radius=12) txt_sh = font.render("CỬA HÀNG VẬT PHẨM", True, BLACK) screen.blit(txt_sh, (btn_shop.x + (btn_shop.width - txt_sh.get_width()) // 2, btn_shop.y + 14)) elif game_state == "SHOP": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((10, 10, 20, 235)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) title = font_large.render("🛒 CỬA HÀNG TRANG BỊ & NÂNG CẤP", True, GOLD) screen.blit(title, (WIDTH // 2 - col_width // 2, start_y + 5 * row_height rect = pygame.Rect(bx, by, col_width, 44) is_hover = rect.collidepoint(mx, my) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (60, 65, 95) if is_hover else (32, 32, 48), rect, border_radius=10) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GOLD if is_hover else (85, 85, 110), rect, 2, border_radius=10) draw_super_polished_icon(screen, rect.x + 8, rect.y + 2, item["id"], is_hover) lvl = shop_upgrades[item["id"]] screen.blit(font.render(f"{item['name']} [LV {lvl}]", True, WHITE), (rect.x + 58, rect.y + 6)) cost = item["base_cost"] + (lvl * 30) cost_txt = font.render(f"Giá: {cost}", True, GOLD) screen.blit(cost_txt, (rect.x + 58, rect.y + 24)) draw_coin_icon(screen, rect.x + 58 + cost_txt.get_width() + 12, rect.y + 32, 7) btn_back = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 50, 220, 38) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GRAY, btn_back, border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, btn_back, 2, border_radius=8) screen.blit(font.render("QUAY LẠI MENU", True, WHITE), (btn_back.x + 45, btn_back.y + 10)) elif game_state in ["PLAYING", "LEVEL_UP"]: player.draw() for coin in coins: coin.draw() for bullet in bullets: bullet.draw() for zombie in zombies: zombie.draw(player.x, player.y) for exp in explosions: exp.draw() # Thông tin góc trái screen.blit(font.render(f"Cấp: {player.level}", True, GOLD), (10, 10)) screen.blit(font.render(f"Máu: {int(player.hp)} / {int(player.max_hp)}", True, GREEN), (10, 32)) # Thông tin giữa màn hình wave_txt = font_medium.render(f"ĐỢT: {current_wave}", True, CYAN) zombies_remaining = (zombies_to_spawn - zombies_spawned_count) + len(zombies) count_txt = font.render(f"Còn lại: {zombies_remaining} con", True, RED) screen.blit(wave_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - wave_txt.get_width() // 2, 10)) screen.blit(count_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - count_txt.get_width() // 2, 34)) # Tiền vàng draw_coin_icon(screen, WIDTH - 75, 25, 12) screen.blit(font.render(f"{player_gold}", True, GOLD), (WIDTH - 55, 15)) # Thanh XP ở đáy bar_width = WIDTH - 40 bar_height = 10 bar_x, bar_y = 20, HEIGHT - 220, 90)) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() for i, choice in enumerate(current_choices): base_rect = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 200, 180 + i * 85, 400, 65) is_hovered = base_rect.collidepoint(mx, my) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (60, 65, 92) if is_hovered else (32, 32, 45), base_rect, border_radius=12) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GOLD if is_hovered else (85, 85, 110), base_rect, 2, border_radius=12) draw_super_polished_icon(screen, base_rect.x + 12, base_rect.y + 11, choice["id"], is_hovered) screen.blit(font.render(choice["text"], True, WHITE), (base_rect.x + 68, base_rect.y + 20)) elif game_state == "GAME_OVER": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((25, 5, 5, 235)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) screen.blit(font_title.render("THẤT BẠI", True, RED), (WIDTH // 2 - Mỗi icon hiện tại được vẽ đa tầng với hiệu ứng viền phát sáng (glow), đổ bóng chéo, mặt phẳng nổi (bevel effect) và các chi tiết đặc trưng sắc nét hơn rất nhiều. Dưới đây là toàn bộ code đã được cập nhật hoàn chỉnh: Python import pygame import random import math pygame.init() # Cấu hình màn hình WIDTH, HEIGHT = 900, 650 screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT)) pygame.display.set_caption("2D Tank vs Zombies - Ultimate Edition") clock = pygame.time.Clock() # Bảng màu sắc đồ họa cao cấp WHITE = (255, 255, 255) BLACK = (10, 10, 15) RED = (255, 60, 60) DARK_RED = (120, 10, 10) GREEN = (45, 240, 120) YELLOW = (255, 230, 60) GRAY = (55, 55, 70) BLUE = (50, 180, 255) ORANGE = (255, 130, 20) CYAN = (0, 245, 245) GOLD = (255, 210, 60) PURPLE = (190, 90, 255) font = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 16, bold=True) font_medium = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 20, bold=True) font_large = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 30, bold=True) font_title = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 52, bold=True) # Biến lưu tiền và cấp độ nâng cấp trong Shop player_gold = 500 shop_upgrades = { "maxhp": 0, "dmg": 0, "spd": 0, "multishot": 0, "pierce": 0, "rate": 0, "vampire": 0, "explosive": 0, "nova": 0 } # Quản lý Đợt (Wave) current_wave = 1 zombies_to_spawn = 20 zombies_spawned_count = 0 spawn_timer = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False # Nền chiến trường random.seed(100) BG_DECORATIONS = [] for _ in range(35): BG_DECORATIONS.append({ "type": random.choice(["crater", "rock", "crack", "oil_pool"]), "x": random.randint(50, WIDTH - 50), "y": random.randint(50, HEIGHT - 50), "size": random.randint(20, 55) }) random.seed() def draw_battlefield_background(surface): surface.fill((20, 20, 28)) for deco in BG_DECORATIONS: if deco["type"] == "crater": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (14, 14, 20), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, (28, 28, 38), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"], 2) elif deco["type"] == "oil_pool": oil_surf = pygame.Surface((deco["size"]*2, deco["size"]), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(oil_surf, (10, 10, 15, 120), (0, 0, deco["size"]*2, deco["size"])) surface.blit(oil_surf, (deco["x"] - deco["size"], deco["y"] - deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "rock": pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (32, 32, 44), (deco["x"] - deco["size"]//2, deco["y"] - deco["size"]//4, deco["size"], deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "crack": pygame.draw.line(surface, (15, 15, 22), (deco["x"] - 12, deco["y"]), (deco["x"] + 18, deco["y"] + 14), 2) def draw_coin_icon(surface, x, y, radius=10): pygame.draw.circle(surface, (180, 120, 10), (x + 1, y + 2), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, GOLD, (x, y), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (x, y), radius - 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (x - 3, y - 3), 2) # HÀM ĐỒ HỌA ICON ĐƯỢC NÂNG CẤP ĐẸP MẮT (3D GLOSSY & DETAILED VECTORS) def draw_super_polished_icon(surface, x, y, skill_id, is_hovered): size = 42 offset = -2 if is_hovered else 0 nx, ny = x + offset, y + offset # Glow khi di chuột qua if is_hovered: glow_surf = pygame.Surface((size + 16, size + 16), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.rect(glow_surf, (255, 215, 0, 120), (0, 0, size + 16, size + 16), border_radius=12) surface.blit(glow_surf, (nx - 8, ny - 8)) # Khung nền 3D pygame.draw.rect(surface, (8, 8, 12), (nx + 2, ny + 4, size, size), border_radius=10) bg_color = (48, 52, 75) if is_hovered else (28, 30, 42) pygame.draw.rect(surface, bg_color, (nx, ny, size, size), border_radius=10) # Viền sáng bevel border_col = GOLD if is_hovered else (110, 115, 140) pygame.draw.rect(surface, border_col, (nx, ny, size, size), 2, border_radius=10) cx, cy = nx + size // 2, ny + size // 2 # VẼ CHI TIẾT TỪNG ICON KỸ NĂNG if skill_id == "maxhp": # Khiên bảo vệ + Trái tim 3D pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (30, 100, 200), [(cx, cy - 14), (cx + 12, cy - 8), (cx + 10, cy + 6), (cx, cy + 14), (cx - 10, cy + 6), (cx - 12, cy - 8)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (80, 170, 255), [(cx, cy - 12), (cx + 10, cy - 7), (cx + 8, cy + 5), (cx, cy + 12), (cx - 8, cy + 5), (cx - 10, cy - 7)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx - 3, cy - 2), 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx + 3, cy - 2), 3) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx - 6, cy - 1), (cx + 6, cy - 1), (cx, cy + 6)]) elif skill_id == "dmg": # Kiếm ánh sáng bắt chéo pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx - 11, cy + 11), (cx + 11, cy - 11), 3) pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx - 10, cy + 10), (cx + 10, cy - 10), 2) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx + 11, cy - 11), (cx + 7, cy - 12), (cx + 12, cy - 7)]) pygame.draw.rect(surface, GOLD, (cx - 11, cy + 7, 5, 5)) elif skill_id == "spd": # Động cơ phản lực pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (180, 180, 200), [(cx - 8, cy - 10), (cx + 10, cy - 4), (cx + 10, cy + 4), (cx - 8, cy + 10)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, CYAN, [(cx + 10, cy - 5), (cx + 16, cy), (cx + 10, cy + 5)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, ORANGE, [(cx - 8, cy - 6), (cx - 15, cy), (cx - 8, cy + 6)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, YELLOW, [(cx - 8, cy - 3), (cx - 12, cy), (cx - 8, cy + 3)]) elif skill_id == "multishot": # 3 Nòng súng bắn đạn tỏa for angle in [-20, 0, 20]: rad = math.radians(angle) ex = cx + math.cos(rad) * 12 ey = cy + math.sin(rad) * 12 pygame.draw.line(surface, GRAY, (cx - 6, cy), (ex, ey), 4) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (int(ex + math.cos(rad)*4), int(ey + math.sin(rad)*4)), 3) elif skill_id == "pierce": # Đạn xuyên thấu tên lửa pygame.draw.rect(surface, (180, 180, 190), (cx - 12, cy - 4, 16, 8), border_radius=2) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx + 4, cy - 6), (cx + 14, cy), (cx + 4, cy + 6)]) pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx - 14, cy), (cx - 10, cy), 3) elif skill_id == "rate": # Đồng hồ tốc độ bắn pygame.draw.circle(surface, (40, 180, 100), (cx, cy), 12, 3) pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx, cy), (cx + 6, cy - 6), 2) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, YELLOW, [(cx + 4, cy - 10), (cx + 8, cy - 8), (cx + 5, cy - 4)]) elif skill_id == "vampire": # Giọt máu Quỷ phát sáng pygame.draw.circle(surface, DARK_RED, (cx, cy + 2), 8) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, DARK_RED, [(cx - 8, cy + 2), (cx + 8, cy + 2), (cx, cy - 10)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx, cy + 2), 6) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx - 6, cy + 2), (cx + 6, cy + 2), (cx, cy - 8)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (cx - 2, cy - 1), 2) elif skill_id == "explosive": # Quả bom nổ 3D pygame.draw.circle(surface, (20, 20, 20), (cx - 2, cy + 2), 9) pygame.draw.circle(surface, (60, 60, 65), (cx - 2, cy + 2), 7) pygame.draw.line(surface, GOLD, (cx, cy - 5), (cx + 6, cy - 11), 2) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx + 7, cy - 12), 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (cx + 7, cy - 12), 1) elif skill_id == "nova": # Sóng kích nổ Điện từ pygame.draw.circle(surface, PURPLE, (cx, cy), 12, 2) pygame.draw.circle(surface, CYAN, (cx, cy), 7, 2) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (cx, cy), 3) for i in range(4): ang = i * (math.pi / 2) pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx + math.cos(ang)*7, cy + math.sin(ang)*7), (cx + math.cos(ang)*13, cy + math.sin(ang)*13), 2) UPGRADE_POOL = [ {"id": "multishot", "text": "Pháo Đa Nòng (+1 Đạn)"}, {"id": "pierce", "text": "Đạn Xuyên Thấu (+1 Quái)"}, {"id": "explosive", "text": "Đạn Pháo Nổ Diện Rộng"}, {"id": "vampire", "text": "Hút Máu Khi Diệt Quái"}, {"id": "nova", "text": "Sóng Nổ Quét Bản Đồ"}, {"id": "dmg", "text": "+20% Sát Thương Pháo"}, {"id": "spd", "text": "+15% Tốc Độ Động Cơ"}, {"id": "rate", "text": "+20% Tốc Độ Bắn"}, {"id": "maxhp", "text": "+25% Máu Tối Đa"} ] class Coin: def __init__(self, x, y, value): self.x, self.y = x, y self.value = value self.radius = 8 def draw(self): shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((18, 12), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(shadow_surf, (0, 0, 0, 100), (0, 0, 18, 12)) screen.blit(shadow_surf, (int(self.x) - 9, int(self.y) - 3)) draw_coin_icon(screen, int(self.x), int(self.y), self.radius) class Explosion: def __init__(self, x, y, radius): self.x, self.y = x, y self.max_radius = radius self.current_radius = 6 self.alpha = 255 def update(self): self.current_radius += 5 self.alpha -= 18 return self.alpha <= 0 or self.current_radius >= self.max_radius def draw(self): surf = pygame.Surface((self.max_radius * 2, self.max_radius * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA) color = (255, 140, 20, max(0, self.alpha)) core_color = (255, 240, 150, max(0, self.alpha)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, core_color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius * 0.4)) screen.blit(surf, (self.x - self.max_radius, self.y - self.max_radius)) class TankPlayer: def __init__(self): self.reset() def reset(self): self.x, self.y = WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2 self.speed = 3.5 + (shop_upgrades["spd"] * 0.4) self.max_hp = 120 + (shop_upgrades["maxhp"] * 30) self.hp = self.max_hp self.damage = 30 + (shop_upgrades["dmg"] * 8) self.level = 1 self.exp = 0 self.exp_to_next_level = 100 self.fire_rate = max(100, 300 - (shop_upgrades["rate"] * 30)) self.last_shot = 0 self.bullet_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["multishot"] self.pierce_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["pierce"] self.explosive_bullets = shop_upgrades["explosive"] > 0 self.vampirism = shop_upgrades["vampire"] * 2 def draw(self): px, py = int(self.x), int(self.y) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() gun_angle = math.atan2(my - py, mx - px) shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((50, 40), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(shadow_surf, (0, 0, 0, 140), (0, 0, 50, 40)) screen.blit(shadow_surf, (px - 25, py - 14)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (35, 55, 30), (px - 20, py - 16, 40, 32), border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (55, 90, 45), (px - 17, py - 13, 34, 26), border_radius=6) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (px - 22, py - 18, 8, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (px + 14, py - 18, 8, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, (40, 65, 30), (px, py), 13) pygame.draw.circle(screen, (60, 95, 45), (px, py), 10) ex_x, ex_y = px + math.cos(gun_angle) * 28, py + math.sin(gun_angle) * 28 pygame.draw.line(screen, (20, 20, 25), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 8) pygame.draw.line(screen, (45, 45, 55), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 4) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (self.x - 24, self.y - 50, 48, 8), border_radius=3) hp_width = max(0, 44 * (self.hp / self.max_hp)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (self.x - 22, self.y - 48, hp_width, 4), border_radius=2) def move(self, keys): dx, dy = 0, 0 if keys[pygame.K_w] and self.y > 30: dy -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_s] and self.y < HEIGHT - 30: dy += 1 if keys[pygame.K_a] and self.x > 30: dx -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_d] and self.x < WIDTH - 30: dx += 1 if dx != 0 or dy != 0: length = math.hypot(dx, dy) self.x += (dx / length) * self.speed self.y += (dy / length) * self.speed def add_exp(self, amount): self.exp += amount leveled_up = False while self.exp >= self.exp_to_next_level: self.exp -= self.exp_to_next_level self.level += 1 self.exp_to_next_level = self.level * 100 leveled_up = True return leveled_up class Bullet: def __init__(self, x, y, angle_rad, damage, pierce, is_explosive): self.x, self.y = x, y self.damage = damage self.speed = 13 self.dx = math.cos(angle_rad) * self.speed self.dy = math.sin(angle_rad) * self.speed self.pierce = pierce self.is_explosive = is_explosive def update(self): self.x += self.dx self.y += self.dy def draw(self): color = ORANGE if self.is_explosive else YELLOW pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, (int(self.x), int(self.y)), 5) # Lớp Zombie dùng chính xác đồ họa từ code 2 class Zombie: def __init__(self, is_boss=False, tier=1): side = random.choice(['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']) if side == 'top': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), -45 elif side == 'bottom': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), HEIGHT + 45 elif side == 'left': self.x, self.y = -45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) else: self.x, self.y = WIDTH + 45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) self.is_boss = is_boss self.tier = tier if is_boss: self.type = "TANK" self.radius, self.speed, self.hp = 28, 1.2 + (tier * 0.1), 850 + (tier * 220) self.max_hp = self.hp self.skin_color = (40, 70, 50) # Xanh thẫm độc hại self.shirt_color = (30, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 1000, 150 else: self.type = "NORMAL" if tier == 1 else "FAST" self.radius = 16 if tier == 1 else 13 self.speed = random.uniform(1.3, 1.8) + (tier - 1) * 0.2 self.hp = self.max_hp = 50 + (tier - 1) * 35 self.skin_color = (80, 130, 70) if tier == 1 else (130, 60, 50) self.shirt_color = (60, 60, 90) if tier == 1 else (100, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 15 + (tier - 1) * 5, 10 + (tier - 1) * 5 def update(self, px, py): angle = math.atan2(py - self.y, px - self.x) self.x += math.cos(angle) * self.speed self.y += math.sin(angle) * self.speed def draw(self, px, py): ix, iy = int(self.x), int(self.y) angle = math.atan2(py - iy, px - ix) cos_a = math.cos(angle) sin_a = math.sin(angle) # 1. Hai vai áo rộng shoulder_w = self.radius * 1.1 p1_x = ix + cos_a * 2 - sin_a * shoulder_w p1_y = iy + sin_a * 2 + cos_a * shoulder_w p2_x = ix + cos_a * 2 + sin_a * shoulder_w p2_y = iy + sin_a * 2 - cos_a * shoulder_w pygame.draw.line(screen, self.shirt_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (p2_x, p2_y), int(self.radius * 0.8)) # 2. Hai cánh tay vươn về phía trước arm_len = self.radius * 1.5 arm1_x = p1_x + cos_a * arm_len arm1_y = p1_y + sin_a * arm_len arm2_x = p2_x + cos_a * arm_len arm2_y = p2_y + sin_a * arm_len pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (arm1_x, arm1_y), 4) pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p2_x, p2_y), (arm2_x, arm2_y), 4) # Bàn tay máu pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm1_x), int(arm1_y)), 3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm2_x), int(arm2_y)), 3) # 3. Cái đầu Zombie head_x = ix + cos_a * 4 head_y = iy + sin_a * 4 pygame.draw.circle(screen, self.skin_color, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75)) pygame.draw.circle(screen, BLACK, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75), 2) # 4. Mắt phát sáng dữ tợn eye1_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 - sin_a * 5 eye1_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 + cos_a * 5 eye2_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 + sin_a * 5 eye2_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 - cos_a * 5 pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye1_x), int(eye1_y)), 2) pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye2_x), int(eye2_y)), 2) # Thanh máu Zombie if self.hp < self.max_hp: bar_w = self.radius * 2.2 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, bar_w, 4)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, max(0, bar_w * (self.hp / self.max_hp)), 4)) def apply_upgrade(player, upgrade_id, zombies, explosions): if upgrade_id == "multishot": player.bullet_count = min(5, player.bullet_count + 1) elif upgrade_id == "pierce": player.pierce_count += 1 elif upgrade_id == "explosive": player.explosive_bullets = True elif upgrade_id == "vampire": player.vampirism += 2 elif upgrade_id == "nova": explosions.append(Explosion(player.x, player.y, 220)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - player.x, z.y - player.y) < 220: z.hp -= 70 elif upgrade_id == "dmg": player.damage *= 1.2 elif upgrade_id == "spd": player.speed *= 1.15 elif upgrade_id == "rate": player.fire_rate = max(70, player.fire_rate * 0.8) elif upgrade_id == "maxhp": player.max_hp *= 1.25 player.hp += player.max_hp * 0.25 player = TankPlayer() bullets, zombies, explosions, coins = [], [], [], [] game_state = "MENU" current_choices = [] def reset_game(): global bullets, zombies, explosions, coins, spawn_timer, game_state, current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave player.reset() bullets.clear(); zombies.clear(); explosions.clear(); coins.clear() current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave = 1, 20, 0, False game_state = "PLAYING" running = True while running: clock.tick(60) current_time = pygame.time.get_ticks() for event in pygame.event.get(): if event.type == pygame.QUIT: running = False if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() if game_state == "MENU": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 20, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 80, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "SHOP" elif game_state == "SHOP": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 55, 220, 40).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" shop_items_data = [ ("maxhp", 50), ("dmg", 70), ("spd", 60), ("multishot", 120), ("pierce", 90), ("rate", 80), ("vampire", 150), ("explosive", 200), ("nova", 250) ] col_width, row_height = 420, 50 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - 430, WIDTH // 2 + 10, 90 for i, (item_id, base_cost) in enumerate(shop_items_data): c = 0 if i < 5 else 1 r = i if c == 0 else i - 5 bx = start_x1 if c == 0 else start_x2 by = start_y + r * row_height if i == 8: bx, by = WIDTH // 2 - col_width // 2, start_y + 5 * row_height if pygame.Rect(bx, by, col_width, 44).collidepoint(mx, my): cost = base_cost + (shop_upgrades[item_id] * 30) if player_gold >= cost: player_gold -= cost shop_upgrades[item_id] += 1 player.reset() elif game_state == "LEVEL_UP": for i in range(len(current_choices)): if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 200, 180 + i * 85, 400, 65).collidepoint(mx, my): apply_upgrade(player, current_choices[i]["id"], zombies, explosions) game_state = "PLAYING" break elif game_state == "GAME_OVER": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 10, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 70, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" keys = pygame.key.get_pressed() if game_state == "PLAYING": player.move(keys) if pygame.mouse.get_pressed()[0] and current_time - player.last_shot > player.fire_rate: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() base_angle = math.atan2(my - player.y, mx - player.x) spread, num_bullets = 0.15, player.bullet_count start_angle = base_angle - (spread * (num_bullets - 1) / 2) for i in range(num_bullets): bullets.append(Bullet(player.x, player.y, start_angle + (spread * i), player.damage, player.pierce_count, player.explosive_bullets)) player.last_shot = current_time if zombies_spawned_count < zombies_to_spawn: spawn_timer += 1 if spawn_timer >= 30: tier = (current_wave - 1) // 10 + 1 zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=False, tier=tier)) zombies_spawned_count += 1 spawn_timer = 0 elif current_wave % 10 == 0 and not boss_spawned_in_wave: zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=True, tier=current_wave // 10)) boss_spawned_in_wave = True elif zombies_spawned_count >= zombies_to_spawn and len(zombies) == 0: current_wave += 1 zombies_to_spawn = current_wave * 20 zombies_spawned_count = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False for bullet in bullets[:]: bullet.update() if not (0 <= bullet.x <= WIDTH and 0 <= bullet.y <= HEIGHT): bullets.remove(bullet) for exp in explosions[:]: if exp.update(): explosions.remove(exp) for coin in coins[:]: if math.hypot(coin.x - player.x, coin.y - player.y) < 25: player_gold += coin.value coins.remove(coin) for zombie in zombies[:]: zombie.update(player.x, player.y) if math.hypot(zombie.x - player.x, zombie.y - player.y) < zombie.radius + 16: player.hp -= 0.5 if player.hp <= 0: game_state = "GAME_OVER" for bullet in bullets[:]: if math.hypot(zombie.x - bullet.x, zombie.y - bullet.y) < zombie.radius + 4: zombie.hp -= bullet.damage if bullet.is_explosive: explosions.append(Explosion(bullet.x, bullet.y, 85)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - bullet.x, z.y - bullet.y) < 85: z.hp -= bullet.damage * 0.5 bullet.pierce -= 1 if bullet.pierce <= 0 and bullet in bullets: bullets.remove(bullet) if zombie.hp <= 0: coins.append(Coin(zombie.x, zombie.y, zombie.gold_drop)) if player.vampirism > 0: player.hp = min(player.max_hp, player.hp + player.vampirism) zombies.remove(zombie) if player.add_exp(zombie.exp_reward): game_state = "LEVEL_UP" current_choices = random.sample(UPGRADE_POOL, 3) break draw_battlefield_background(screen) if game_state == "MENU": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((10, 10, 20, 180)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) title_txt = font_title.render("TANK VS ZOMBIES", True, GREEN) screen.blit(title_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - Python import pygame import random import math pygame.init() # Cấu hình màn hình WIDTH, HEIGHT = 900, 650 screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT)) pygame.display.set_caption("2D Tank vs Zombies - Ultimate Edition") clock = pygame.time.Clock() # Bảng màu sắc đồ họa cao cấp WHITE = (255, 255, 255) BLACK = (10, 10, 15) RED = (255, 60, 60) DARK_RED = (120, 10, 10) GREEN = (45, 240, 120) YELLOW = (255, 230, 60) GRAY = (55, 55, 70) BLUE = (50, 180, 255) ORANGE = (255, 130, 20) CYAN = (0, 245, 245) GOLD = (255, 210, 60) PURPLE = (190, 90, 255) font = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 16, bold=True) font_medium = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 20, bold=True) font_large = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 30, bold=True) font_title = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 52, bold=True) # Biến lưu tiền và cấp độ nâng cấp trong Shop player_gold = 500 shop_upgrades = { "maxhp": 0, "dmg": 0, "spd": 0, "multishot": 0, "pierce": 0, "rate": 0, "vampire": 0, "explosive": 0, "nova": 0 } # Quản lý Đợt (Wave) - Đã chỉnh lại wave 1 chỉ có 10 zombie current_wave = 1 zombies_to_spawn = 10 zombies_spawned_count = 0 spawn_timer = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False # Nền chiến trường random.seed(100) BG_DECORATIONS = [] for _ in range(35): BG_DECORATIONS.append({ "type": random.choice(["crater", "rock", "crack", "oil_pool"]), "x": random.randint(50, WIDTH - 50), "y": random.randint(50, HEIGHT - 50), "size": random.randint(20, 55) }) random.seed() def draw_battlefield_background(surface): surface.fill((20, 20, 28)) for deco in BG_DECORATIONS: if deco["type"] == "crater": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (14, 14, 20), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, (28, 28, 38), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"], 2) elif deco["type"] == "oil_pool": oil_surf = pygame.Surface((deco["size"]*2, deco["size"]), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(oil_surf, (10, 10, 15, 120), (0, 0, deco["size"]*2, deco["size"])) surface.blit(oil_surf, (deco["x"] - deco["size"], deco["y"] - deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "rock": pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (32, 32, 44), (deco["x"] - deco["size"]//2, deco["y"] - deco["size"]//4, deco["size"], deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "crack": pygame.draw.line(surface, (15, 15, 22), (deco["x"] - 12, deco["y"]), (deco["x"] + 18, deco["y"] + 14), 2) def draw_coin_icon(surface, x, y, radius=10): pygame.draw.circle(surface, (180, 120, 10), (x + 1, y + 2), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, GOLD, (x, y), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (x, y), radius - 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (x - 3, y - 3), 2) # HÀM ĐỒ HỌA ICON ĐƯỢC NÂNG CẤP ĐẸP MẮT (3D GLOSSY & DETAILED VECTORS) def draw_super_polished_icon(surface, x, y, skill_id, is_hovered): size = 42 offset = -2 if is_hovered else 0 nx, ny = x + offset, y + offset if is_hovered: glow_surf = pygame.Surface((size + 16, size + 16), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.rect(glow_surf, (255, 215, 0, 120), (0, 0, size + 16, size + 16), border_radius=12) surface.blit(glow_surf, (nx - 8, ny - 8)) pygame.draw.rect(surface, (8, 8, 12), (nx + 2, ny + 4, size, size), border_radius=10) bg_color = (48, 52, 75) if is_hovered else (28, 30, 42) pygame.draw.rect(surface, bg_color, (nx, ny, size, size), border_radius=10) border_col = GOLD if is_hovered else (110, 115, 140) pygame.draw.rect(surface, border_col, (nx, ny, size, size), 2, border_radius=10) cx, cy = nx + size // 2, ny + size // 2 if skill_id == "maxhp": pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (30, 100, 200), [(cx, cy - 14), (cx + 12, cy - 8), (cx + 10, cy + 6), (cx, cy + 14), (cx - 10, cy + 6), (cx - 12, cy - 8)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (80, 170, 255), [(cx, cy - 12), (cx + 10, cy - 7), (cx + 8, cy + 5), (cx, cy + 12), (cx - 8, cy + 5), (cx - 10, cy - 7)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx - 3, cy - 2), 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx + 3, cy - 2), 3) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx - 6, cy - 1), (cx + 6, cy - 1), (cx, cy + 6)]) elif skill_id == "dmg": pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx - 11, cy + 11), (cx + 11, cy - 11), 3) pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx - 10, cy + 10), (cx + 10, cy - 10), 2) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx + 11, cy - 8, cy + 2), (cx + 8, cy + 2), (cx, cy - 10)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx, cy + 2), 6) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx - 6, cy + 2), (cx + 6, cy + 2), (cx, cy - 8)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (cx - 2, cy - 1), 2) elif skill_id == "explosive": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (20, 20, 20), (cx - 2, cy + 2), 9) pygame.draw.circle(surface, (60, 60, 65), (cx - 2, cy + 2), 7) pygame.draw.line(surface, GOLD, (cx, cy - 5), (cx + 6, cy - 11), 2) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx + 7, cy - 12), 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (cx + 7, cy - 12), 1) elif skill_id == "nova": pygame.draw.circle(surface, PURPLE, (cx, cy), 12, 2) pygame.draw.circle(surface, CYAN, (cx, cy), 7, 2) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (cx, cy), 3) for i in range(4): ang = i * (math.pi / 2) pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx + math.cos(ang)*7, cy + math.sin(ang)*7), (cx + math.cos(ang)*13, cy + math.sin(ang)*13), 2) UPGRADE_POOL = [ {"id": "multishot", "text": "Pháo Đa Nòng (+1 Đạn)"}, {"id": "pierce", "text": "Đạn Xuyên Thấu (+1 Quái)"}, {"id": "explosive", "text": "Đạn Pháo Nổ Diện Rộng"}, {"id": "vampire", "text": "Hút Máu Khi Diệt Quái"}, {"id": "nova", "text": "Sóng Nổ Quét Bản Đồ"}, {"id": "dmg", "text": "+20% Sát Thương Pháo"}, {"id": "spd", "text": "+15% Tốc Độ Động Cơ"}, {"id": "rate", "text": "+20% Tốc Độ Bắn"}, {"id": "maxhp", "text": "+25% Máu Tối Đa"} ] class Coin: def __init__(self, x, y, value): self.x, self.y = x, y self.value = value self.radius = 8 def draw(self): shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((18, 12), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(shadow_surf, (0, 0, 0, 100), (0, 0, 18, 12)) screen.blit(shadow_surf, (int(self.x) - 9, int(self.y) - 3)) draw_coin_icon(screen, int(self.x), int(self.y), self.radius) class Explosion: def __init__(self, x, y, radius): self.x, self.y = x, y self.max_radius = radius self.current_radius = 6 self.alpha = 255 def update(self): self.current_radius += 5 self.alpha -= 18 return self.alpha <= 0 or self.current_radius >= self.max_radius def draw(self): surf = pygame.Surface((self.max_radius * 2, self.max_radius * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA) color = (255, 140, 20, max(0, self.alpha)) core_color = (255, 240, 150, max(0, self.alpha)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, core_color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius * 0.4)) screen.blit(surf, (self.x - self.max_radius, self.y - self.max_radius)) class TankPlayer: def __init__(self): self.reset() def reset(self): self.x, self.y = WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2 self.speed = 3.5 + (shop_upgrades["spd"] * 0.4) self.max_hp = 120 + (shop_upgrades["maxhp"] * 30) self.hp = self.max_hp self.damage = 30 + (shop_upgrades["dmg"] * 8) self.level = 1 self.exp = 0 self.exp_to_next_level = 100 self.fire_rate = max(100, 300 - (shop_upgrades["rate"] * 30)) self.last_shot = 0 self.bullet_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["multishot"] self.pierce_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["pierce"] self.explosive_bullets = shop_upgrades["explosive"] > 0 self.vampirism = shop_upgrades["vampire"] * 2 def draw(self): px, py = int(self.x), int(self.y) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() gun_angle = math.atan2(my - py, mx - px) shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((50, 40), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(shadow_surf, (0, 0, 0, 140), (0, 0, 50, 40)) screen.blit(shadow_surf, (px - 25, py - 14)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (35, 55, 30), (px - 20, py - 16, 40, 32), border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (55, 90, 45), (px - 17, py - 13, 34, 26), border_radius=6) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (px - 22, py - 18, 8, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (px + 14, py - 18, 8, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, (40, 65, 30), (px, py), 13) pygame.draw.circle(screen, (60, 95, 45), (px, py), 10) ex_x, ex_y = px + math.cos(gun_angle) * 28, py + math.sin(gun_angle) * 28 pygame.draw.line(screen, (20, 20, 25), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 8) pygame.draw.line(screen, (45, 45, 55), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 4) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (self.x - 24, self.y - 50, 48, 8), border_radius=3) hp_width = max(0, 44 * (self.hp / self.max_hp)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (self.x - 22, self.y - 48, hp_width, 4), border_radius=2) def move(self, keys): dx, dy = 0, 0 if keys[pygame.K_w] and self.y > 30: dy -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_s] and self.y < HEIGHT - 30: dy += 1 if keys[pygame.K_a] and self.x > 30: dx -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_d] and self.x < WIDTH - 30: dx += 1 if dx != 0 or dy != 0: length = math.hypot(dx, dy) self.x += (dx / length) * self.speed self.y += (dy / length) * self.speed def add_exp(self, amount): self.exp += amount leveled_up = False while self.exp >= self.exp_to_next_level: self.exp -= self.exp_to_next_level self.level += 1 self.exp_to_next_level = self.level * 100 leveled_up = True return leveled_up class Bullet: def __init__(self, x, y, angle_rad, damage, pierce, is_explosive): self.x, self.y = x, y self.damage = damage self.speed = 13 self.dx = math.cos(angle_rad) * self.speed self.dy = math.sin(angle_rad) * self.speed self.pierce = pierce self.is_explosive = is_explosive def update(self): self.x += self.dx self.y += self.dy def draw(self): color = ORANGE if self.is_explosive else YELLOW pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, (int(self.x), int(self.y)), 5) class Zombie: def __init__(self, is_boss=False, tier=1): side = random.choice(['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']) if side == 'top': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), -45 elif side == 'bottom': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), HEIGHT + 45 elif side == 'left': self.x, self.y = -45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) else: self.x, self.y = WIDTH + 45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) self.is_boss = is_boss self.tier = tier if is_boss: self.type = "TANK" self.radius, self.speed, self.hp = 28, 1.2 + (tier * 0.1), 850 + (tier * 220) self.max_hp = self.hp self.skin_color = (40, 70, 50) self.shirt_color = (30, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 1000, 150 else: self.type = "NORMAL" if tier == 1 else "FAST" self.radius = 16 if tier == 1 else 13 self.speed = random.uniform(1.3, 1.8) + (tier - 1) * 0.2 self.hp = self.max_hp = 50 + (tier - 1) * 35 self.skin_color = (80, 130, 70) if tier == 1 else (130, 60, 50) self.shirt_color = (60, 60, 90) if tier == 1 else (100, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 15 + (tier - 1) * 5, 10 + (tier - 1) * 5 def update(self, px, py): angle = math.atan2(py - self.y, px - self.x) self.x += math.cos(angle) * self.speed self.y += math.sin(angle) * self.speed def draw(self, px, py): ix, iy = int(self.x), int(self.y) angle = math.atan2(py - iy, px - ix) cos_a = math.cos(angle) sin_a = math.sin(angle) shoulder_w = self.radius * 1.1 p1_x = ix + cos_a * 2 - sin_a * shoulder_w p1_y = iy + sin_a * 2 + cos_a * shoulder_w p2_x = ix + cos_a * 2 + sin_a * shoulder_w p2_y = iy + sin_a * 2 - cos_a * shoulder_w pygame.draw.line(screen, self.shirt_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (p2_x, p2_y), int(self.radius * 0.8)) arm_len = self.radius * 1.5 arm1_x = p1_x + cos_a * arm_len arm1_y = p1_y + sin_a * arm_len arm2_x = p2_x + cos_a * arm_len arm2_y = p2_y + sin_a * arm_len pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (arm1_x, arm1_y), 4) pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p2_x, p2_y), (arm2_x, arm2_y), 4) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm1_x), int(arm1_y)), 3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm2_x), int(arm2_y)), 3) head_x = ix + cos_a * 4 head_y = iy + sin_a * 4 pygame.draw.circle(screen, self.skin_color, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75)) pygame.draw.circle(screen, BLACK, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75), 2) eye1_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 - sin_a * 5 eye1_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 + cos_a * 5 eye2_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 + sin_a * 5 eye2_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 - cos_a * 5 pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye1_x), int(eye1_y)), 2) pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye2_x), int(eye2_y)), 2) if self.hp < self.max_hp: bar_w = self.radius * 2.2 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, bar_w, 4)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, max(0, bar_w * (self.hp / self.max_hp)), 4)) def apply_upgrade(player, upgrade_id, zombies, explosions): if upgrade_id == "multishot": player.bullet_count = min(5, player.bullet_count + 1) elif upgrade_id == "pierce": player.pierce_count += 1 elif upgrade_id == "explosive": player.explosive_bullets = True elif upgrade_id == "vampire": player.vampirism += 2 elif upgrade_id == "nova": explosions.append(Explosion(player.x, player.y, 220)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - player.x, z.y - player.y) < 220: z.hp -= 70 elif upgrade_id == "dmg": player.damage *= 1.2 elif upgrade_id == "spd": player.speed *= 1.15 elif upgrade_id == "rate": player.fire_rate = max(70, player.fire_rate * 0.8) elif upgrade_id == "maxhp": player.max_hp *= 1.25 player.hp += player.max_hp * 0.25 player = TankPlayer() bullets, zombies, explosions, coins = [], [], [], [] game_state = "MENU" current_choices = [] def reset_game(): global bullets, zombies, explosions, coins, spawn_timer, game_state, current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave player.reset() bullets.clear(); zombies.clear(); explosions.clear(); coins.clear() current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave = 1, 10, 0, False game_state = "PLAYING" running = True while running: clock.tick(60) current_time = pygame.time.get_ticks() for event in pygame.event.get(): if event.type == pygame.QUIT: running = False if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() if game_state == "MENU": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 55, 220, 40).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" shop_items_data = [ ("maxhp", 50), ("dmg", 70), ("spd", 60), ("multishot", 120), ("pierce", 90), ("rate", 80), ("vampire", 150), ("explosive", 200), ("nova", 250) ] col_width, row_height = 420, 50 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - player.last_shot > player.fire_rate: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() base_angle = math.atan2(my - player.y, mx - player.x) spread, num_bullets = 0.15, player.bullet_count start_angle = base_angle - (spread * (num_bullets - 1) / 2) for i in range(num_bullets): bullets.append(Bullet(player.x, player.y, start_angle + (spread * i), player.damage, player.pierce_count, player.explosive_bullets)) player.last_shot = current_time if zombies_spawned_count < zombies_to_spawn: spawn_timer += 1 if spawn_timer >= 30: tier = (current_wave - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 70, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GRAY, btn_menu, border_radius=12) screen.blit(font.render("VỀ MENU CHÍNH", True, WHITE), (btn_menu.x + 45, btn_menu.y + 14)) pygame.display.flip() pygame.quit() conf tier cuả tank đâu Hiện tại xe tăng của người chơi (lớp TankPlayer) chưa được phân chia theo Tier (cấp độ/đời xe), mà chỉ có Zombie mới đang có chỉ số tier phân loại. Dưới đây là mã nguồn đã được bổ sung hệ thống Tier cho Xe Tăng: Tier 1 (Xe Nhẹ): Nòng đơn, di chuyển nhanh. Tier 2 (Xe Trung): Tự động mở khóa ở Wave 5 (Thân xe bọc thép xám, nòng đôi song song, tăng 30% sát thương & máu). Tier 3 (Xe Hạng Nặng/Sát Thủ): Tự động mở khóa ở Wave 10 (Thân xe bọc vàng/đen, nòng pháo cỡ đại phát sáng, tăng mạnh sát thương, máu và tốc độ bắn). 12, deco["y"]), (deco["x"] + 18, deco["y"] + 14), 2) def draw_coin_icon(surface, x, y, radius=10): pygame.draw.circle(surface, (180, 120, 10), (x + 1, y + 2), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, GOLD, (x, y), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (x, y), radius - 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (x - 3, y - 3), 2) def draw_super_polished_icon(surface, x, y, skill_id, is_hovered): size = 42 offset = -2 if is_hovered else 0 nx, ny = x + offset, y + offset if is_hovered: glow_surf = pygame.Surface((size + 16, size + 16), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.rect(glow_surf, (255, 215, 0, 120), (0, 0, size + 16, size + 16), border_radius=12) surface.blit(glow_surf, (nx - 9, int(self.y) - 3)) draw_coin_icon(screen, int(self.x), int(self.y), self.radius) class Explosion: def __init__(self, x, y, radius): self.x, self.y = x, y self.max_radius = radius self.current_radius = 6 self.alpha = 255 def update(self): self.current_radius += 5 self.alpha -= 18 return self.alpha <= 0 or self.current_radius >= self.max_radius def draw(self): surf = pygame.Surface((self.max_radius * 2, self.max_radius * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA) color = (255, 140, 20, max(0, self.alpha)) core_color = (255, 240, 150, max(0, self.alpha)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, core_color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius * 0.4)) screen.blit(surf, (self.x - self.max_radius, self.y - self.max_radius)) # LỚP XE TĂNG ĐÃ THÊM CẤP ĐỘ TIER class TankPlayer: def __init__(self): self.tier = 1 self.reset() def update_tier(self, wave): old_tier = self.tier if wave >= 10: self.tier = 3 elif wave >= 5: self.tier = 2 else: self.tier = 1 if old_tier != self.tier: self.recalculate_stats() def recalculate_stats(self): # Hệ số chỉ số theo Tier tier_hp_bonus = 1.0 + (self.tier - 1) * 0.35 tier_dmg_bonus = 1.0 + (self.tier - 1) * 0.3 self.speed = (3.5 + (shop_upgrades["spd"] * 0.4)) * (1 + (self.tier - 1) * 0.1) prev_max_hp = self.max_hp if hasattr(self, 'max_hp') else 120 self.max_hp = (120 + (shop_upgrades["maxhp"] * 30)) * tier_hp_bonus self.hp += (self.max_hp - prev_max_hp) if hasattr(self, 'hp') else self.max_hp self.damage = (30 + (shop_upgrades["dmg"] * 8)) * tier_dmg_bonus self.fire_rate = max(80, (300 - (shop_upgrades["rate"] * 30)) * (1.0 - (self.tier - 1) * 0.15)) def reset(self): self.x, self.y = WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2 self.level = 1 self.exp = 0 self.exp_to_next_level = 100 self.last_shot = 0 self.bullet_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["multishot"] self.pierce_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["pierce"] self.explosive_bullets = shop_upgrades["explosive"] > 0 self.vampirism = shop_upgrades["vampire"] * 2 self.recalculate_stats() self.hp = self.max_hp def draw(self): px, py = int(self.x), int(self.y) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() gun_angle = math.atan2(my - py, mx - px) # Đổ bóng shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((55, 45), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(shadow_surf, (0, 0, 0, 140), (0, 0, 55, 45)) screen.blit(shadow_surf, (px - 27, py - 16)) # Đồ họa khác nhau theo Tier if self.tier == 1: # Xe Tăng Hạng Nhẹ pygame.draw.rect(screen, (35, 55, 30), (px - 20, py - 16, 40, 32), border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (55, 90, 45), (px - 17, py - 13, 34, 26), border_radius=6) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (px - 22, py - 18, 8, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (px + 14, py - 18, 8, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, (40, 65, 30), (px, py), 13) pygame.draw.circle(screen, (60, 95, 45), (px, py), 10) ex_x, ex_y = px + math.cos(gun_angle) * 28, py + math.sin(gun_angle) * 28 pygame.draw.line(screen, (20, 20, 25), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 7) elif self.tier == 2: # Xe Tăng Hạng Trung (Thân Xám Metal, Nòng Đôi) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (50, 55, 65), (px - 22, py - 18, 44, 36), border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (80, 90, 105), (px - 19, py - 15, 38, 30), border_radius=6) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (25, 25, 30), (px - 25, py - 20, 9, 40), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (25, 25, 30), (px + 16, py - 20, 9, 40), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, (60, 70, 85), (px, py), 15) pygame.draw.circle(screen, CYAN, (px, py), 11) # Nòng đôi perp_x = -math.sin(gun_angle) * 4 perp_y = math.cos(gun_angle) * 4 ex1_x, ex1_y = px + perp_x + math.cos(gun_angle) * 30, py + perp_y + math.sin(gun_angle) * 30 ex2_x, ex2_y = px - perp_x + math.cos(gun_angle) * 30, py - perp_y + math.sin(gun_angle) * 30 pygame.draw.line(screen, (30, 30, 35), (px + perp_x, py + perp_y), (ex1_x, ex1_y), 5) pygame.draw.line(screen, (30, 30, 35), (px - perp_x, py - perp_y), (ex2_x, ex2_y), 5) else: # Tier 3: Xe Tăng Hạng Nặng / Sát Thủ (Hoàng Kim, Pháo Khổng Lồ) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (120, 80, 20), (px - 25, py - 20, 50, 40), border_radius=10) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GOLD, (px - 21, py - 16, 42, 32), border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (20, 20, 25), (px - 28, py - 23, 10, 46), border_radius=4) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (20, 20, 25), (px + 18, py - 23, 10, 46), border_radius=4) pygame.draw.circle(screen, ORANGE, (px, py), 17) pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED, (px, py), 12) # Nòng đại pháo ex_x, ex_y = px + math.cos(gun_angle) * 34, py + math.sin(gun_angle) * 34 pygame.draw.line(screen, (20, 20, 20), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 11) pygame.draw.line(screen, GOLD, (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 7) pygame.draw.circle(screen, CYAN, (int(ex_x), int(ex_y)), 5) # Thanh máu pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (self.x - 24, self.y - 50, 48, 8), border_radius=3) hp_width = max(0, 44 * (self.hp / self.max_hp)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (self.x - 22, self.y - 48, hp_width, 4), border_radius=2) def move(self, keys): dx, dy = 0, 0 if keys[pygame.K_w] and self.y > 30: dy -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_s] and self.y < HEIGHT - 30: dy += 1 if keys[pygame.K_a] and self.x > 30: dx -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_d] and self.x < WIDTH - 30: dx += 1 if dx != 0 or dy != 0: length = math.hypot(dx, dy) self.x += (dx / length) * self.speed self.y += (dy / length) * self.speed def add_exp(self, amount): self.exp += amount leveled_up = False while self.exp >= self.exp_to_next_level: self.exp -= self.exp_to_next_level self.level += 1 self.exp_to_next_level = self.level * 100 leveled_up = True return leveled_up class Bullet: def __init__(self, x, y, angle_rad, damage, pierce, is_explosive): self.x, self.y = x, y self.damage = damage self.speed = 13 self.dx = math.cos(angle_rad) * self.speed self.dy = math.sin(angle_rad) * self.speed self.pierce = pierce self.is_explosive = is_explosive def update(self): self.x += self.dx self.y += self.dy def draw(self): color = ORANGE if self.is_explosive else YELLOW pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, (int(self.x), int(self.y)), 5) class Zombie: def __init__(self, is_boss=False, tier=1): side = random.choice(['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']) if side == 'top': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), -45 elif side == 'bottom': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), HEIGHT + 45 elif side == 'left': self.x, self.y = -45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) else: self.x, self.y = WIDTH + 45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) self.is_boss = is_boss self.tier = tier if is_boss: self.type = "TANK" self.radius, self.speed, self.hp = 28, 1.2 + (tier * 0.1), 850 + (tier * 220) self.max_hp = self.hp self.skin_color = (40, 70, 50) self.shirt_color = (30, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 1000, 150 else: self.type = "NORMAL" if tier == 1 else "FAST" self.radius = 16 if tier == 1 else 13 self.speed = random.uniform(1.3, 1.8) + (tier - 1) * 0.2 self.hp = self.max_hp = 50 + (tier - 1) * 35 self.skin_color = (80, 130, 70) if tier == 1 else (130, 60, 50) self.shirt_color = (60, 60, 90) if tier == 1 else (100, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 15 + (tier - 1) * 5, 10 + (tier - 1) * 5 def update(self, px, py): angle = math.atan2(py - self.y, px - self.x) self.x += math.cos(angle) * self.speed self.y += math.sin(angle) * self.speed def draw(self, px, py): ix, iy = int(self.x), int(self.y) angle = math.atan2(py - iy, px - ix) cos_a = math.cos(angle) sin_a = math.sin(angle) shoulder_w = self.radius * 1.1 p1_x = ix + cos_a * 2 - sin_a * shoulder_w p1_y = iy + sin_a * 2 + cos_a * shoulder_w p2_x = ix + cos_a * 2 + sin_a * shoulder_w p2_y = iy + sin_a * 2 - cos_a * shoulder_w pygame.draw.line(screen, self.shirt_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (p2_x, p2_y), int(self.radius * 0.8)) arm_len = self.radius * 1.5 arm1_x = p1_x + cos_a * arm_len arm1_y = p1_y + sin_a * arm_len arm2_x = p2_x + cos_a * arm_len arm2_y = p2_y + sin_a * arm_len pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (arm1_x, arm1_y), 4) pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p2_x, p2_y), (arm2_x, arm2_y), 4) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm1_x), int(arm1_y)), 3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm2_x), int(arm2_y)), 3) head_x = ix + cos_a * 4 head_y = iy + sin_a * 4 pygame.draw.circle(screen, self.skin_color, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75)) pygame.draw.circle(screen, BLACK, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75), 2) eye1_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 - sin_a * 5 eye1_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 + cos_a * 5 eye2_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 + sin_a * 5 eye2_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 - cos_a * 5 pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye1_x), int(eye1_y)), 2) pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye2_x), int(eye2_y)), 2) if self.hp < self.max_hp: bar_w = self.radius * 2.2 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, bar_w, 4)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, max(0, bar_w * (self.hp / self.max_hp)), 4)) def apply_upgrade(player, upgrade_id, zombies, explosions): if upgrade_id == "multishot": player.bullet_count = min(5, player.bullet_count + 1) elif upgrade_id == "pierce": player.pierce_count += 1 elif upgrade_id == "explosive": player.explosive_bullets = True elif upgrade_id == "vampire": player.vampirism += 2 elif upgrade_id == "nova": explosions.append(Explosion(player.x, player.y, 220)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - player.x, z.y - player.y) < 220: z.hp -= 70 elif upgrade_id == "dmg": player.damage *= 1.2 elif upgrade_id == "spd": player.speed *= 1.15 elif upgrade_id == "rate": player.fire_rate = max(70, player.fire_rate * 0.8) elif upgrade_id == "maxhp": player.max_hp *= 1.25 player.hp += player.max_hp * 0.25 player = TankPlayer() bullets, zombies, explosions, coins = [], [], [], [] game_state = "MENU" current_choices = [] def reset_game(): global bullets, zombies, explosions, coins, spawn_timer, game_state, current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave player.reset() bullets.clear(); zombies.clear(); explosions.clear(); coins.clear() current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave = 1, 10, 0, False player.update_tier(current_wave) game_state = "PLAYING" running = True while running: clock.tick(60) current_time = pygame.time.get_ticks() for event in pygame.event.get(): if event.type == pygame.QUIT: running = False if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() if game_state == "MENU": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 20, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 80, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "SHOP" elif game_state == "SHOP": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 55, 220, 40).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" shop_items_data = [ ("maxhp", 50), ("dmg", 70), ("spd", 60), ("multishot", 120), ("pierce", 90), ("rate", 80), ("vampire", 150), ("explosive", 200), ("nova", 250) ] col_width, row_height = 420, 50 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - self.max_radius, self.y - self.max_radius)) # LỚP XE TĂNG ĐÃ THÊM CẤP ĐỘ TIER[cite: 2] class TankPlayer: def __init__(self): self.tier = 1 self.reset() def update_tier(self, wave): old_tier = self.tier if wave >= 10: self.tier = 3 elif wave >= 5: self.tier = 2 else: self.tier = 1 if old_tier != self.tier: self.recalculate_stats() def recalculate_stats(self): tier_hp_bonus = 1.0 + (self.tier - 1) * 0.35 tier_dmg_bonus = 1.0 + (self.tier - 1) * 0.3 self.speed = (3.5 + (shop_upgrades["spd"] * 0.4)) * (1 + (self.tier - 1) * 0.1) prev_max_hp = self.max_hp if hasattr(self, 'max_hp') else 120 self.max_hp = (120 + (shop_upgrades["maxhp"] * 30)) * tier_hp_bonus self.hp += (self.max_hp - prev_max_hp) if hasattr(self, 'hp') else self.max_hp self.damage = (30 + (shop_upgrades["dmg"] * 8)) * tier_dmg_bonus self.fire_rate = max(80, (300 - (shop_upgrades["rate"] * 30)) * (1.0 - (self.tier - 1) * 0.15)) def reset(self): self.x, self.y = WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2 self.level = 1 self.exp = 0 self.exp_to_next_level = 100 self.last_shot = 0 self.bullet_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["multishot"] self.pierce_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["pierce"] self.explosive_bullets = shop_upgrades["explosive"] > 0 self.vampirism = shop_upgrades["vampire"] * 2 self.recalculate_stats() self.hp = self.max_hp def draw(self): px, py = int(self.x), int(self.y) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() gun_angle = math.atan2(my -
