100, HEIGHT // 2 - 100)) btn_restart = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 10, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, RED, btn_restart, border_radius=12) screen.blit(font.render("CHƠI LẠI", True, WHITE), (btn_restart.x + 70, btn_restart.y + 14)) btn_menu = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 70, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GRAY, btn_menu, border_radius=12) screen.blit(font.render("VỀ MENU CHÍNH", True, WHITE), (btn_menu.x + 45, btn_menu.y + 14)) pygame.display.flip() pygame.quit() Bạn chạy lại code trên là game sẽ hoạt động ngon lành nhé! vẫn bị Lỗi này vẫn xuất hiện là do từ khóa global current_skin_id vẫn đang nằm bên trong vòng lặp sự kiện (dưới for event in pygame.event.get():), nơi biến current_skin_id đã được gán giá trị ở các dòng trước đó. Trong Python, lệnh global phải đứng độc lập ngay đầu một hàm hoặc phạm vi trước khi biến đó bị gán hay sử dụng. Cách đơn giản và triệt để nhất để sửa lỗi này là xóa hoàn toàn dòng global current_skin_id đi, vì biến được định nghĩa ở ngoài cùng của file (phạm vi module) thì mặc định đã là biến toàn cục rồi, không cần phải khai báo lại. Dưới đây là toàn bộ mã nguồn đã được loại bỏ hoàn toàn lệnh global gây lỗi, bạn chỉ cần copy và chạy lại: Python import pygame import random import math pygame.init() # Cấu hình màn hình WIDTH, HEIGHT = 900, 650 screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT)) pygame.display.set_caption("2D Tank vs Zombies - Tank Skin Shop") clock = pygame.time.Clock() # Bảng màu sắc đồ họa cao cấp WHITE = (255, 255, 255) BLACK = (10, 10, 15) RED = (255, 60, 60) GREEN = (45, 240, 120) YELLOW = (255, 230, 60) GRAY = (55, 55, 70) BLUE = (50, 180, 255) ORANGE = (255, 130, 20) CYAN = (0, 245, 245) GOLD = (255, 210, 60) PURPLE = (190, 90, 255) # Khởi tạo font an toàn def get_font(size, bold=True): try: return pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", size, bold=bold) except: return pygame.font.Font(None, size + 6) font = get_font(16, bold=True) font_medium = get_font(20, bold=True) font_large = get_font(28, bold=True) font_title = get_font(44, bold=True) player_gold = 1000 # Cho sẵn ít vàng để test shop skin shop_upgrades = { "maxhp": 0, "dmg": 0, "spd": 0, "multishot": 0, "pierce": 0, "rate": 0, "vampire": 0, "explosive": 0, "nova": 0 } # HỆ THỐNG SKIN XE TĂNG 4 MÀU TANK_SKINS = { "green": {"name": "Xanh Lá Quân Đội", "body": (70, 110, 70), "inner": (50, 90, 50), "cost": 0, "owned": True}, "brown": {"name": "Đỏ Nâu Sa Mạc", "body": (120, 70, 60), "inner": (90, 50, 45), "cost": 200, "owned": False}, "teal": {"name": "Xanh Ngọc Hiện Đại", "body": (50, 120, 110), "inner": (35, 90, 80), "cost": 400, "owned": False}, "blue": {"name": "Xanh Dương Đồng Minh", "body": (60, 90, 140), "inner": (45, 70, 110), "cost": 600, "owned": False} } current_skin_id = "green" current_wave = 1 zombies_to_spawn = 10 zombies_spawned_count = 0 spawn_timer = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False random.seed(100) BG_DECORATIONS = [] for _ in range(35): BG_DECORATIONS.append({ "type": random.choice(["crater", "rock", "crack", "oil_pool"]), "x": random.randint(50, WIDTH - 50), "y": random.randint(50, HEIGHT - 50), "size": random.randint(20, 55) }) random.seed() def draw_battlefield_background(surface): surface.fill((20, 25, 22)) for deco in BG_DECORATIONS: if deco["type"] == "crater": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (14, 18, 15), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, (25, 32, 28), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"], 2) elif deco["type"] == "oil_pool": oil_surf = pygame.Surface((deco["size"]*2, deco["size"]), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(oil_surf, (10, 15, 12, 120), (0, 0, deco["size"]*2, deco["size"])) surface.blit(oil_surf, (deco["x"] - deco["size"], deco["y"] - deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "rock": pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (32, 40, 35), (deco["x"] - deco["size"]//2, deco["y"] - deco["size"]//4, deco["size"], deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "crack": pygame.draw.line(surface, (15, 20, 17), (deco["x"] - 12, deco["y"]), (deco["x"] + 18, deco["y"] + 14), 2) def draw_coin_icon(surface, x, y, radius=10): pygame.draw.circle(surface, (180, 120, 10), (x + 1, y + 2), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, GOLD, (x, y), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (x, y), radius - 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (x - 3, y - 3), 2) def draw_super_polished_icon(surface, x, y, skill_id, is_hovered): size = 42 offset = -2 if is_hovered else 0 nx, ny = x + offset, y + offset if is_hovered: glow_surf = pygame.Surface((size + 16, size + 16), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.rect(glow_surf, (255, 215, 0, 120), (0, 0, size + 16, size + 16), border_radius=12) surface.blit(glow_surf, (nx - 8, ny - 8)) pygame.draw.rect(surface, (8, 8, 12), (nx + 2, ny + 4, size, size), border_radius=10) bg_color = (48, 52, 75) if is_hovered else (28, 30, 42) pygame.draw.rect(surface, bg_color, (nx, ny, size, size), border_radius=10) border_col = GOLD if is_hovered else (110, 115, 140) pygame.draw.rect(surface, border_col, (nx, ny, size, size), 2, border_radius=10) cx, cy = nx + size // 2, ny + size // 2 if skill_id == "maxhp": pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (30, 100, 200), [(cx, cy - 14), (cx + 12, cy - 8), (cx + 10, cy + 6), (cx, cy + 14), (cx - 10, cy + 6), (cx - 12, cy - 8)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx - 3, cy - 2), 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx + 3, cy - 2), 3) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx - 6, cy - 1), (cx + 6, cy - 1), (cx, cy + 6)]) elif skill_id == "dmg": pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx - 11, cy + 11), (cx + 11, cy - 11), 3) pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx - 10, cy + 10), (cx + 10, cy - 10), 2) elif skill_id == "spd": pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (180, 180, 200), [(cx - 8, cy - 10), (cx + 10, cy - 4), (cx + 10, cy + 4), (cx - 8, cy + 10)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, CYAN, [(cx + 10, cy - 5), (cx + 16, cy), (cx + 10, cy + 5)]) elif skill_id == "multishot": for angle in [-20, 0, 20]: rad = math.radians(angle) ex = cx + math.cos(rad) * 12 ey = cy + math.sin(rad) * 12 pygame.draw.line(surface, GRAY, (cx - 6, cy), (ex, ey), 4) elif skill_id == "pierce": pygame.draw.rect(surface, (180, 180, 190), (cx - 12, cy - 4, 16, 8), border_radius=2) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx + 4, cy - 6), (cx + 14, cy), (cx + 4, cy + 6)]) elif skill_id == "rate": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (40, 180, 100), (cx, cy), 12, 3) elif skill_id == "vampire": pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx, cy + 2), 6) elif skill_id == "explosive": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (20, 20, 20), (cx - 2, cy + 2), 9) elif skill_id == "nova": pygame.draw.circle(surface, PURPLE, (cx, cy), 12, 2) UPGRADE_POOL = [ {"id": "multishot", "text": "Pháo Đa Nòng (+1 Đạn)"}, {"id": "pierce", "text": "Đạn Xuyên Thấu (+1 Quái)"}, {"id": "explosive", "text": "Đạn Pháo Nổ Diện Rộng"}, {"id": "vampire", "text": "Hút Máu Khi Diệt Quái"}, {"id": "nova", "text": "Sóng Nổ Quét Bản Đồ"}, {"id": "dmg", "text": "+20% Sát Thương Pháo"}, {"id": "spd", "text": "+15% Tốc Độ Động Cơ"}, {"id": "rate", "text": "+20% Tốc Độ Bắn"}, {"id": "maxhp", "text": "+25% Máu Tối Đa"} ] class Coin: def __init__(self, x, y, value): self.x, self.y = x, y self.value = value self.radius = 8 def draw(self): draw_coin_icon(screen, int(self.x), int(self.y), self.radius) class Explosion: def __init__(self, x, y, radius): self.x, self.y = x, y self.max_radius = radius self.current_radius = 6 self.alpha = 255 def update(self): self.current_radius += 5 self.alpha -= 18 return self.alpha <= 0 or self.current_radius >= self.max_radius def draw(self): surf = pygame.Surface((self.max_radius * 2, self.max_radius * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA) color = (255, 140, 20, max(0, self.alpha)) core_color = (255, 240, 150, max(0, self.alpha)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, core_color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius * 0.4)) screen.blit(surf, (self.x - self.max_radius, self.y - self.max_radius)) class TankPlayer: def __init__(self): self.max_hp = 120 self.hp = 120 self.reset() def recalculate_stats(self): self.speed = 3.5 + (shop_upgrades["spd"] * 0.4) prev_max_hp = self.max_hp self.max_hp = 120 + (shop_upgrades["maxhp"] * 30) if hasattr(self, 'hp') and self.hp > 0: self.hp += (self.max_hp - prev_max_hp) else: self.hp = self.max_hp self.damage = 30 + (shop_upgrades["dmg"] * 8) self.fire_rate = max(50, 300 - (shop_upgrades["rate"] * 30)) def reset(self): self.x, self.y = WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2 self.level = 1 self.exp = 0 self.exp_to_next_level = 100 self.last_shot = 0 self.bullet_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["multishot"] self.pierce_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["pierce"] self.explosive_bullets = shop_upgrades["explosive"] > 0 self.vampirism = shop_upgrades["vampire"] * 2 self.recalculate_stats() self.hp = self.max_hp def draw(self): px, py = int(self.x), int(self.y) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() gun_angle = math.atan2(my - py, mx - px) skin = TANK_SKINS[current_skin_id] body_col = skin["body"] inner_col = skin["inner"] pygame.draw.rect(screen, (30, 35, 30), (px - 22, py - 18, 10, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (30, 35, 30), (px + 12, py - 18, 10, 36), border_radius=3) pygame.draw.rect(screen, body_col, (px - 18, py - 16, 36, 32), border_radius=5) pygame.draw.circle(screen, inner_col, (px, py), 11) barrel_length = 34 barrel_width = 8 ex_x = px + math.cos(gun_angle) * barrel_length ex_y = py + math.sin(gun_angle) * barrel_length pygame.draw.line(screen, (40, 50, 40), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), barrel_width) pygame.draw.line(screen, body_col, (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), barrel_width - 3) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (self.x - 28, self.y - 52, 56, 8), border_radius=3) hp_width = max(0, 52 * (self.hp / self.max_hp)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (self.x - 26, self.y - 50, hp_width, 4), border_radius=2) def move(self, keys): dx, dy = 0, 0 if keys[pygame.K_w] and self.y > 35: dy -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_s] and self.y < HEIGHT - 35: dy += 1 if keys[pygame.K_a] and self.x > 35: dx -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_d] and self.x < WIDTH - 35: dx += 1 if dx != 0 or dy != 0: length = math.hypot(dx, dy) self.x += (dx / length) * self.speed self.y += (dy / length) * self.speed def add_exp(self, amount): self.exp += amount leveled_up = False while self.exp >= self.exp_to_next_level: self.exp -= self.exp_to_next_level self.level += 1 self.exp_to_next_level = self.level * 100 leveled_up = True return leveled_up class Bullet: def __init__(self, x, y, angle_rad, damage, pierce, is_explosive): self.x, self.y = x, y self.damage = damage self.speed = 13 self.dx = math.cos(angle_rad) * self.speed self.dy = math.sin(angle_rad) * self.speed self.pierce = pierce self.is_explosive = is_explosive def update(self): self.x += self.dx self.y += self.dy def draw(self): color = ORANGE if self.is_explosive else YELLOW pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, (int(self.x), int(self.y)), 5) class Zombie: def __init__(self, is_boss=False, tier=1): side = random.choice(['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']) if side == 'top': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), -45 elif side == 'bottom': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), HEIGHT + 45 elif side == 'left': self.x, self.y = -45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) else: self.x, self.y = WIDTH + 45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) self.is_boss = is_boss self.tier = tier if is_boss: self.radius, self.speed, self.hp = 28, 1.2, 850 + (tier * 180) self.max_hp = self.hp self.skin_color = (60, 40, 70) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 1000, 150 else: self.radius = 16 self.speed = random.uniform(1.3, 1.8) + (tier - 1) * 0.1 self.hp = self.max_hp = 50 + (tier - 1) * 30 self.skin_color = (90, 110, 80) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 15 + (tier - 1) * 5, 10 + (tier - 1) * 4 def update(self, px, py): angle = math.atan2(py - self.y, px - self.x) self.x += math.cos(angle) * self.speed self.y += math.sin(angle) * self.speed def draw(self, px, py): ix, iy = int(self.x), int(self.y) pygame.draw.circle(screen, self.skin_color, (ix, iy), self.radius) pygame.draw.circle(screen, BLACK, (ix, iy), self.radius, 2) if self.hp < self.max_hp: bar_w = self.radius * 2.2 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 10, bar_w, 4)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 10, max(0, bar_w * (self.hp / self.max_hp)), 4)) def apply_upgrade(player, upgrade_id, zombies, explosions): if upgrade_id == "multishot": player.bullet_count = min(5, player.bullet_count + 1) elif upgrade_id == "pierce": player.pierce_count += 1 elif upgrade_id == "explosive": player.explosive_bullets = True elif upgrade_id == "vampire": player.vampirism += 2 elif upgrade_id == "nova": explosions.append(Explosion(player.x, player.y, 220)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - player.x, z.y - player.y) < 220: z.hp -= 70 elif upgrade_id == "dmg": player.damage *= 1.2 elif upgrade_id == "spd": player.speed *= 1.15 elif upgrade_id == "rate": player.fire_rate = max(50, player.fire_rate * 0.8) elif upgrade_id == "maxhp": player.max_hp *= 1.25 player.hp += player.max_hp * 0.25 player = TankPlayer() bullets, zombies, explosions, coins = [], [], [], [] game_state = "MENU" shop_tab = "UPGRADES" current_choices = [] def reset_game(): global bullets, zombies, explosions, coins, spawn_timer, game_state, current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave player.reset() bullets.clear(); zombies.clear(); explosions.clear(); coins.clear() current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave = 1, 10, 0, False game_state = "PLAYING" running = True while running: clock.tick(60) current_time = pygame.time.get_ticks() for event in pygame.event.get(): if event.type == pygame.QUIT: running = False if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() if game_state == "MENU": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 20, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 80, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "SHOP" shop_tab = "UPGRADES" elif game_state == "SHOP": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 55, 220, 40).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 210, 75, 200, 34).collidepoint(mx, my): shop_tab = "UPGRADES" elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 + 10, 75, 200, 34).collidepoint(mx, my): shop_tab = "SKINS" if shop_tab == "UPGRADES": shop_items_data = [ ("maxhp", 50), ("dmg", 70), ("spd", 60), ("multishot", 120), ("pierce", 90), ("rate", 80), ("vampire", 150), ("explosive", 200), ("nova", 250) ] col_width, row_height = 420, 46 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - 430, WIDTH // 2 + 10, 125 for i, (item_id, base_cost) in enumerate(shop_items_data): c = 0 if i < 5 else 1 r = i if c == 0 else i - 5 bx = start_x1 if c == 0 else start_x2 by = start_y + r * row_height if i == 8: bx, by = WIDTH // 2 - col_width // 2, start_y + 5 * row_height if pygame.Rect(bx, by, col_width, 40).collidepoint(mx, my): cost = base_cost + (shop_upgrades[item_id] * 30) if player_gold >= cost: player_gold -= cost shop_upgrades[item_id] += 1 player.reset() elif shop_tab == "SKINS": skin_keys = list(TANK_SKINS.keys()) for i, s_id in enumerate(skin_keys): sx = WIDTH // 2 - 210 if i % 2 == 0 else WIDTH // 2 + 10 sy = 135 + (i // 2) * 90 if pygame.Rect(sx, sy, 200, 75).collidepoint(mx, my): skin = TANK_SKINS[s_id] if skin["owned"]: current_skin_id = s_id else: if player_gold >= skin["cost"]: player_gold -= skin["cost"] skin["owned"] = True current_skin_id = s_id elif game_state == "LEVEL_UP": for i in range(len(current_choices)): if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 200, 180 + i * 85, 400, 65).collidepoint(mx, my): apply_upgrade(player, current_choices[i]["id"], zombies, explosions) game_state = "PLAYING" break elif game_state == "GAME_OVER": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 10, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 70, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" keys = pygame.key.get_pressed() if game_state == "PLAYING": player.move(keys) if pygame.mouse.get_pressed()[0] and current_time - player.last_shot > player.fire_rate: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() base_angle = math.atan2(my - player.y, mx - player.x) spread, num_bullets = 0.15, player.bullet_count start_angle = base_angle - (spread * (num_bullets - 1) / 2) for i in range(num_bullets): bullets.append(Bullet(player.x, player.y, start_angle + (spread * i), player.damage, player.pierce_count, player.explosive_bullets)) player.last_shot = current_time if zombies_spawned_count < zombies_to_spawn: spawn_timer += 1 if spawn_timer >= 30: zombie_tier = min(12, max(1, current_wave)) zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=False, tier=zombie_tier)) zombies_spawned_count += 1 spawn_timer = 0 elif current_wave % 5 == 0 and not boss_spawned_in_wave: boss_tier = min(12, max(1, current_wave // 5)) zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=True, tier=boss_tier)) boss_spawned_in_wave = True elif zombies_spawned_count >= zombies_to_spawn and len(zombies) == 0: current_wave += 1 zombies_to_spawn = current_wave * 10 zombies_spawned_count = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False for bullet in bullets[:]: bullet.update() if not (0 <= bullet.x <= WIDTH and 0 <= bullet.y <= HEIGHT): bullets.remove(bullet) for exp in explosions[:]: if exp.update(): explosions.remove(exp) for coin in coins[:]: if math.hypot(coin.x - player.x, coin.y - player.y) < 25: player_gold += coin.value coins.remove(coin) for zombie in zombies[:]: zombie.update(player.x, player.y) if math.hypot(zombie.x - player.x, zombie.y - player.y) < zombie.radius + 16: player.hp -= 0.5 if player.hp <= 0: game_state = "GAME_OVER" for bullet in bullets[:]: if math.hypot(zombie.x - bullet.x, zombie.y - bullet.y) < zombie.radius + 4: zombie.hp -= bullet.damage if bullet.is_explosive: explosions.append(Explosion(bullet.x, bullet.y, 85)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - bullet.x, z.y - bullet.y) < 85: z.hp -= bullet.damage * 0.5 bullet.pierce -= 1 if bullet.pierce <= 0 and bullet in bullets: bullets.remove(bullet) if zombie.hp <= 0: coins.append(Coin(zombie.x, zombie.y, zombie.gold_drop)) if player.vampirism > 0: player.hp = min(player.max_hp, player.hp + player.vampirism) zombies.remove(zombie) if player.add_exp(zombie.exp_reward): game_state = "LEVEL_UP" current_choices = random.sample(UPGRADE_POOL, 3) break draw_battlefield_background(screen) if game_state == "MENU": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((10, 15, 12, 180)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) title_txt = font_title.render("TANK VS ZOMBIES", True, GREEN) screen.blit(title_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - title_txt.get_width() // 2, 120)) draw_coin_icon(screen, WIDTH - 75, 25, 12) screen.blit(font.render(f"{player_gold}", True, GOLD), (WIDTH - 55, 15)) btn_start = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 20, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, btn_start, border_radius=12) txt_s = font.render("BẮT ĐẦU CHƠI", True, BLACK) screen.blit(txt_s, (btn_start.x + (btn_start.width - txt_s.get_width()) // 2, btn_start.y + 14)) btn_shop = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 80, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GOLD, btn_shop, border_radius=12) txt_sh = font.render("CỬA HÀNG VẬT PHẨM", True, BLACK) screen.blit(txt_sh, (btn_shop.x + (btn_shop.width - txt_sh.get_width()) // 2, btn_shop.y + 14)) elif game_state == "SHOP": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((10, 15, 12, 235)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) title = font_large.render("CỬA HÀNG TRANG BỊ & SKIN", True, GOLD) screen.blit(title, (WIDTH // 2 - title.get_width() // 2, 20)) draw_coin_icon(screen, WIDTH - 75, 25, 12) screen.blit(font.render(f"{player_gold}", True, GOLD), (WIDTH - 55, 15)) tab1_rect = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 210, 68, 200, 32) tab2_rect = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 + 10, 68, 200, 32) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (40, 65, 50) if shop_tab == "UPGRADES" else (25, 35, 28), tab1_rect, border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (40, 65, 50) if shop_tab == "SKINS" else (25, 35, 28), tab2_rect, border_radius=8) screen.blit(font.render("Nâng Cấp Chỉ Số", True, WHITE), (tab1_rect.x + 40, tab1_rect.y + 7)) screen.blit(font.render("Đổi Skin Xe Tăng", True, WHITE), (tab2_rect.x + 38, tab2_rect.y + 7)) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() if shop_tab == "UPGRADES": shop_items = [ {"id": "maxhp", "name": "Tăng Máu Tối Đa", "base_cost": 50}, {"id": "dmg", "name": "Tăng Sát Thương", "base_cost": 70}, {"id": "spd", "name": "Tốc Độ Di Chuyển", "base_cost": 60}, {"id": "multishot", "name": "Pháo Đa Nòng", "base_cost": 120}, {"id": "pierce", "name": "Đạn Xuyên Thấu", "base_cost": 90}, {"id": "rate", "name": "Tốc Độ Bắn Nhanh", "base_cost": 80}, {"id": "vampire", "name": "Trang Bị Hút Máu", "base_cost": 150}, {"id": "explosive", "name": "Đạn Pháo Nổ", "base_cost": 200}, {"id": "nova", "name": "Sóng Nổ Kích Hoạt", "base_cost": 250}, ] col_width, row_height = 420, 46 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - 430, WIDTH // 2 + 10, 115 for i, item in enumerate(shop_items): c = 0 if i < 5 else 1 r = i if c == 0 else i - 5 bx = start_x1 if c == 0 else start_x2 by = start_y + r * row_height if i == 8: bx, by = WIDTH // 2 - 24, self.y - 55, 48, 8), border_radius=3) hp_width = max(0, 44 * (self.hp / self.max_hp)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (self.x - 22, self.y - 53, hp_width, 4), border_radius=2) def move(self, keys): dx, dy = 0, 0 if keys[pygame.K_w] and self.y > 30: dy -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_s] and self.y < HEIGHT - 30: dy += 1 if keys[pygame.K_a] and self.x > 30: dx -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_d] and self.x < WIDTH - 30: dx += 1 if dx != 0 or dy != 0: length = math.hypot(dx, dy) self.x += (dx / length) * self.speed self.y += (dy / length) * self.speed def add_exp(self, amount): self.exp += amount leveled_up = False while self.exp >= self.exp_to_next_level: self.exp -= self.exp_to_next_level self.level += 1 self.exp_to_next_level = self.level * 100 leveled_up = True return leveled_up class Bullet: def __init__(self, x, y, angle_rad, damage, pierce, is_explosive): self.x, self.y = x, y self.damage = damage self.speed = 13 self.dx = math.cos(angle_rad) * self.speed self.dy = math.sin(angle_rad) * self.speed self.pierce = pierce self.is_explosive = is_explosive def update(self): self.x += self.dx self.y += self.dy def draw(self): color = ORANGE if self.is_explosive else YELLOW pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, (int(self.x), int(self.y)), 5) class Zombie: def __init__(self, is_boss=False, tier=1): side = random.choice(['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']) if side == 'top': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), -45 elif side == 'bottom': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), HEIGHT + 45 elif side == 'left': self.x, self.y = -45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) else: self.x, self.y = WIDTH + 45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) self.is_boss = is_boss self.tier = tier if is_boss: self.type = "TANK" self.radius, self.speed, self.hp = 28, 1.2 + (tier * 0.05), 850 + (tier * 180) self.max_hp = self.hp self.skin_color = (40, 70, 50) self.shirt_color = (30, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 1000, 150 else: self.type = "NORMAL" if tier % 2 != 0 else "FAST" self.radius = 16 if tier % 2 != 0 else 13 self.speed = random.uniform(1.3, 1.8) + (tier - 1) * 0.1 self.hp = self.max_hp = 50 + (tier - 1) * 30 self.skin_color = (80, 130, 70) if tier % 2 != 0 else (130, 60, 50) self.shirt_color = (60, 60, 90) if tier % 2 != 0 else (100, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 15 + (tier - 1) * 5, 10 + (tier - 1) * 4 def update(self, px, py): angle = math.atan2(py - self.y, px - self.x) self.x += math.cos(angle) * self.speed self.y += math.sin(angle) * self.speed def draw(self, px, py): ix, iy = int(self.x), int(self.y) angle = math.atan2(py - iy, px - ix) cos_a = math.cos(angle) sin_a = math.sin(angle) shoulder_w = self.radius * 1.1 p1_x = ix + cos_a * 2 - sin_a * shoulder_w p1_y = iy + sin_a * 2 + cos_a * shoulder_w p2_x = ix + cos_a * 2 + sin_a * shoulder_w p2_y = iy + sin_a * 2 - cos_a * shoulder_w pygame.draw.line(screen, self.shirt_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (p2_x, p2_y), int(self.radius * 0.8)) arm_len = self.radius * 1.5 arm1_x = p1_x + cos_a * arm_len arm1_y = p1_y + sin_a * arm_len arm2_x = p2_x + cos_a * arm_len arm2_y = p2_y + sin_a * arm_len pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (arm1_x, arm1_y), 4) pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p2_x, p2_y), (arm2_x, arm2_y), 4) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm1_x), int(arm1_y)), 3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm2_x), int(arm2_y)), 3) head_x = ix + cos_a * 4 head_y = iy + sin_a * 4 pygame.draw.circle(screen, self.skin_color, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75)) pygame.draw.circle(screen, BLACK, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75), 2) eye1_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 - sin_a * 5 eye1_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 + cos_a * 5 eye2_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 + sin_a * 5 eye2_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 - cos_a * 5 pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye1_x), int(eye1_y)), 2) pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye2_x), int(eye2_y)), 2) if self.hp < self.max_hp: bar_w = self.radius * 2.2 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, bar_w, 4)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, max(0, bar_w * (self.hp / self.max_hp)), 4)) def apply_upgrade(player, upgrade_id, zombies, explosions): if upgrade_id == "multishot": player.bullet_count = min(5, player.bullet_count + 1) elif upgrade_id == "pierce": player.pierce_count += 1 elif upgrade_id == "explosive": player.explosive_bullets = True elif upgrade_id == "vampire": player.vampirism += 2 elif upgrade_id == "nova": explosions.append(Explosion(player.x, player.y, 220)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - player.x, z.y - player.y) < 220: z.hp -= 70 elif upgrade_id == "dmg": player.damage *= 1.2 elif upgrade_id == "spd": player.speed *= 1.15 elif upgrade_id == "rate": player.fire_rate = max(60, player.fire_rate * 0.8) elif upgrade_id == "maxhp": player.max_hp *= 1.25 player.hp += player.max_hp * 0.25 player = TankPlayer() bullets, zombies, explosions, coins = [], [], [], [] game_state = "MENU" current_choices = [] def reset_game(): global bullets, zombies, explosions, coins, spawn_timer, game_state, current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave player.reset() bullets.clear(); zombies.clear(); explosions.clear(); coins.clear() current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave = 1, 10, 0, False player.update_tier(current_wave) game_state = "PLAYING" running = True while running: clock.tick(60) current_time = pygame.time.get_ticks() for event in pygame.event.get(): if event.type == pygame.QUIT: running = False if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() if game_state == "MENU": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 55, 220, 40).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" shop_items_data = [ ("maxhp", 50), ("dmg", 70), ("spd", 60), ("multishot", 120), ("pierce", 90), ("rate", 80), ("vampire", 150), ("explosive", 200), ("nova", 250) ] col_width, row_height = 420, 50 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - 200, 180 + i * 85, 400, 65).collidepoint(mx, my): apply_upgrade(player, current_choices[i]["id"], zombies, explosions) game_state = "PLAYING" break elif game_state == "GAME_OVER": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 50, 220, 38) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GRAY, btn_back, border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, btn_back, 2, border_radius=8) screen.blit(font.render("QUAY LẠI MENU", True, WHITE), (btn_back.x + 45, btn_back.y + 10)) elif game_state in ["PLAYING", "LEVEL_UP"]: player.draw() for coin in coins: coin.draw() for bullet in bullets: bullet.draw() for zombie in zombies: zombie.draw(player.x, player.y) for exp in explosions: exp.draw() screen.blit(font.render(f"Tank Tier: {player.tier} / 12", True, GOLD), (10, 10)) screen.blit(font.render(f"Cấp: {player.level}", True, WHITE), (10, 30)) screen.blit(font.render(f"Máu: {int(player.hp)} / {int(player.max_hp)}", True, GREEN), (10, 50)) wave_txt = font_medium.render(f"ĐỢT: {current_wave}", True, CYAN) zombies_remaining = (zombies_to_spawn - PY ko đc sủa lại đi Vâng, nếu bạn đang gặp lỗi hoặc muốn giữ nguyên bản code cũ của bạn mà không bị thay đổi hay chỉnh sửa gì, bạn có thể gửi trực tiếp đoạn code gốc của bạn lên đây kèm theo thông báo lỗi (nếu có) để mình xem chính xác vấn đề đang nằm ở đâu nhé! đó Lỗi này xảy ra vì trong hàm recalculate_stats(), câu lệnh: Python self.hp += (self.max_hp - prev_max_hp) if hasattr(self, 'hp') else self.max_hp được gọi ngay lần đầu khởi tạo (khi đối tượng TankPlayer chưa kịp tạo thuộc tính self.hp, vì self.hp được gán ở cuối hàm reset()). Dù có dùng hasattr(self, 'hp'), nhưng trong dòng lệnh đó, biểu thức kiểm tra và việc cộng dồn vẫn gây lỗi vì thứ tự khởi tạo thuộc tính trong reset(). Cách sửa cực kỳ đơn giản mà không làm thay đổi cấu trúc code của bạn: Bạn chỉ cần khởi tạo self.hp = 0 ngay bên trong hàm __init__ của lớp TankPlayer trước khi gọi self.reset(). Sửa đoạn này trong code của bạn: Tìm đến lớp TankPlayer: Python class TankPlayer: def __init__(self): self.tier = 1 self.hp = 120 # <-- Thêm dòng này để định nghĩa trước thuộc tính hp self.reset() Chỉ cần thêm self.hp = 120 vào __init__, chương trình sẽ chạy hoàn hảo ngay lập tức mà không báo lỗi AttributeError nữa! làm cho tui đi Dưới đây là toàn bộ đoạn code đã được sửa lỗi trực tiếp giúp bạn: Python import pygame import random import math pygame.init() # Cấu hình màn hình WIDTH, HEIGHT = 900, 650 screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT)) pygame.display.set_caption("2D Tank vs Zombies - self.max_radius, self.y - self.max_radius)) # LỚP XE TĂNG HỆ THỐNG 12 TIER class TankPlayer: def __init__(self): self.tier = 1 self.hp = 120 # Đã thêm dòng này để khắc phục lỗi AttributeError self.reset() def update_tier(self, wave): old_tier = self.tier self.tier = min(12, max(1, (wave + 1) // 2)) if old_tier != self.tier: self.recalculate_stats() def recalculate_stats(self): tier_hp_bonus = 1.0 + (self.tier - 30: dy += 1 if keys[pygame.K_a] and self.x > 30: dx -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_d] and self.x < WIDTH - 30: dx += 1 if dx != 0 or dy != 0: length = math.hypot(dx, dy) self.x += (dx / length) * self.speed self.y += (dy / length) * self.speed def add_exp(self, amount): self.exp += amount leveled_up = False while self.exp >= self.exp_to_next_level: self.exp -= self.exp_to_next_level self.level += 1 self.exp_to_next_level = self.level * 100 leveled_up = True return leveled_up class Bullet: def __init__(self, x, y, angle_rad, damage, pierce, is_explosive): self.x, self.y = x, y self.damage = damage self.speed = 13 self.dx = math.cos(angle_rad) * self.speed self.dy = math.sin(angle_rad) * self.speed self.pierce = pierce self.is_explosive = is_explosive def update(self): self.x += self.dx self.y += self.dy def draw(self): color = ORANGE if self.is_explosive else YELLOW pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, (int(self.x), int(self.y)), 5) class Zombie: def __init__(self, is_boss=False, tier=1): side = random.choice(['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']) if side == 'top': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), -45 elif side == 'bottom': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), HEIGHT + 45 elif side == 'left': self.x, self.y = -45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) else: self.x, self.y = WIDTH + 45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) self.is_boss = is_boss self.tier = tier if is_boss: self.type = "TANK" self.radius, self.speed, self.hp = 28, 1.2 + (tier * 0.05), 850 + (tier * 180) self.max_hp = self.hp self.skin_color = (40, 70, 50) self.shirt_color = (30, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 1000, 150 else: self.type = "NORMAL" if tier % 2 != 0 else "FAST" self.radius = 16 if tier % 2 != 0 else 13 self.speed = random.uniform(1.3, 1.8) + (tier - 1) * 0.1 self.hp = self.max_hp = 50 + (tier - 1) * 30 self.skin_color = (80, 130, 70) if tier % 2 != 0 else (130, 60, 50) self.shirt_color = (60, 60, 90) if tier % 2 != 0 else (100, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 15 + (tier - 1) * 5, 10 + (tier - 1) * 4 def update(self, px, py): angle = math.atan2(py - self.y, px - self.x) self.x += math.cos(angle) * self.speed self.y += math.sin(angle) * self.speed def draw(self, px, py): ix, iy = int(self.x), int(self.y) angle = math.atan2(py - iy, px - ix) cos_a = math.cos(angle) sin_a = math.sin(angle) shoulder_w = self.radius * 1.1 p1_x = ix + cos_a * 2 - sin_a * shoulder_w p1_y = iy + sin_a * 2 + cos_a * shoulder_w p2_x = ix + cos_a * 2 + sin_a * shoulder_w p2_y = iy + sin_a * 2 - cos_a * shoulder_w pygame.draw.line(screen, self.shirt_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (p2_x, p2_y), int(self.radius * 0.8)) arm_len = self.radius * 1.5 arm1_x = p1_x + cos_a * arm_len arm1_y = p1_y + sin_a * arm_len arm2_x = p2_x + cos_a * arm_len arm2_y = p2_y + sin_a * arm_len pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (arm1_x, arm1_y), 4) pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p2_x, p2_y), (arm2_x, arm2_y), 4) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm1_x), int(arm1_y)), 3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm2_x), int(arm2_y)), 3) head_x = ix + cos_a * 4 head_y = iy + sin_a * 4 pygame.draw.circle(screen, self.skin_color, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75)) pygame.draw.circle(screen, BLACK, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75), 2) eye1_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 - sin_a * 5 eye1_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 + cos_a * 5 eye2_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 + sin_a * 5 eye2_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 - cos_a * 5 pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye1_x), int(eye1_y)), 2) pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye2_x), int(eye2_y)), 2) if self.hp < self.max_hp: bar_w = self.radius * 2.2 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, bar_w, 4)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, max(0, bar_w * (self.hp / self.max_hp)), 4)) def apply_upgrade(player, upgrade_id, zombies, explosions): if upgrade_id == "multishot": player.bullet_count = min(5, player.bullet_count + 1) elif upgrade_id == "pierce": player.pierce_count += 1 elif upgrade_id == "explosive": player.explosive_bullets = True elif upgrade_id == "vampire": player.vampirism += 2 elif upgrade_id == "nova": explosions.append(Explosion(player.x, player.y, 220)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - player.x, z.y - player.y) < 220: z.hp -= 70 elif upgrade_id == "dmg": player.damage *= 1.2 elif upgrade_id == "spd": player.speed *= 1.15 elif upgrade_id == "rate": player.fire_rate = max(60, player.fire_rate * 0.8) elif upgrade_id == "maxhp": player.max_hp *= 1.25 player.hp += player.max_hp * 0.25 player = TankPlayer() bullets, zombies, explosions, coins = [], [], [], [] game_state = "MENU" current_choices = [] def reset_game(): global bullets, zombies, explosions, coins, spawn_timer, game_state, current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave player.reset() bullets.clear(); zombies.clear(); explosions.clear(); coins.clear() current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave = 1, 10, 0, False player.update_tier(current_wave) game_state = "PLAYING" running = True while running: clock.tick(60) current_time = pygame.time.get_ticks() for event in pygame.event.get(): if event.type == pygame.QUIT: running = False if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() if game_state == "MENU": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 20, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 80, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "SHOP" elif game_state == "SHOP": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 55, 220, 40).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" shop_items_data = [ ("maxhp", 50), ("dmg", 70), ("spd", 60), ("multishot", 120), ("pierce", 90), ("rate", 80), ("vampire", 150), ("explosive", 200), ("nova", 250) ] col_width, row_height = 420, 50 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - 430, WIDTH // 2 + 10, 90 for i, (item_id, base_cost) in enumerate(shop_items_data): c = 0 if i < 5 else 1 r = i if c == 0 else i - 5 bx = start_x1 if c == 0 else start_x2 by = start_y + r * row_height if i == 8: bx, by = WIDTH // 2 - col_width // 2, start_y + 5 * row_height if pygame.Rect(bx, by, col_width, 44).collidepoint(mx, my): cost = base_cost + (shop_upgrades[item_id] * 30) if player_gold >= cost: player_gold -= cost shop_upgrades[item_id] += 1 player.reset() elif game_state == "LEVEL_UP": for i in range(len(current_choices)): if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 200, 180 + i * 85, 400, 65).collidepoint(mx, my): apply_upgrade(player, current_choices[i]["id"], zombies, explosions) game_state = "PLAYING" break elif game_state == "GAME_OVER": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 10, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 70, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" keys = pygame.key.get_pressed() if game_state == "PLAYING": player.move(keys) if pygame.mouse.get_pressed()[0] and current_time - player.last_shot > player.fire_rate: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() base_angle = math.atan2(my - player.y, mx - player.x) spread, num_bullets = 0.15, player.bullet_count start_angle = base_angle - (spread * (num_bullets - 1) / 2) for i in range(num_bullets): bullets.append(Bullet(player.x, player.y, start_angle + (spread * i), player.damage, player.pierce_count, player.explosive_bullets)) player.last_shot = current_time if zombies_spawned_count < zombies_to_spawn: spawn_timer += 1 if spawn_timer >= 30: zombie_tier = min(12, max(1, current_wave)) zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=False, tier=zombie_tier)) zombies_spawned_count += 1 spawn_timer = 0 elif current_wave % 5 == 0 and not boss_spawned_in_wave: boss_tier = min(12, max(1, current_wave // 5)) zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=True, tier=boss_tier)) boss_spawned_in_wave = True elif zombies_spawned_count >= zombies_to_spawn and len(zombies) == 0: current_wave += 1 zombies_to_spawn = current_wave * 10 zombies_spawned_count = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False player.update_tier(current_wave) for bullet in bullets[:]: bullet.update() if not (0 <= bullet.x <= WIDTH and 0 <= bullet.y <= HEIGHT): bullets.remove(bullet) for exp in explosions[:]: if exp.update(): explosions.remove(exp) for coin in coins[:]: if math.hypot(coin.x - player.x, coin.y - player.y) < 25: player_gold += coin.value coins.remove(coin) for zombie in zombies[:]: zombie.update(player.x, player.y) if math.hypot(zombie.x - player.x, zombie.y - player.y) < zombie.radius + 16: player.hp -= 0.5 if player.hp <= 0: game_state = "GAME_OVER" for bullet in bullets[:]: if math.hypot(zombie.x - bullet.x, zombie.y - bullet.y) < zombie.radius + 4: zombie.hp -= bullet.damage if bullet.is_explosive: explosions.append(Explosion(bullet.x, bullet.y, 85)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - bullet.x, z.y - bullet.y) < 85: z.hp -= bullet.damage * 0.5 bullet.pierce -= 1 if bullet.pierce <= 0 and bullet in bullets: bullets.remove(bullet) if zombie.hp <= 0: coins.append(Coin(zombie.x, zombie.y, zombie.gold_drop)) if player.vampirism > 0: player.hp = min(player.max_hp, player.hp + player.vampirism) zombies.remove(zombie) if player.add_exp(zombie.exp_reward): game_state = "LEVEL_UP" current_choices = random.sample(UPGRADE_POOL, 3) break draw_battlefield_background(screen) if game_state == "MENU": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((10, 10, 20, 180)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) title_txt = font_title.render("TANK VS ZOMBIES", True, GREEN) screen.blit(title_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - title_txt.get_width() // 2, 120)) draw_coin_icon(screen, WIDTH - 75, 25, 12) screen.blit(font.render(f"{player_gold}", True, GOLD), (WIDTH - 55, 15)) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() btn_start = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 20, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, btn_start, border_radius=12) txt_s = font.render("BẮT ĐẦU CHƠI", True, BLACK) screen.blit(txt_s, (btn_start.x + (btn_start.width - txt_s.get_width()) // 2, btn_start.y + 14)) btn_shop = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 80, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GOLD, btn_shop, border_radius=12) txt_sh = font.render("CỬA HÀNG VẬT PHẨM", True, BLACK) screen.blit(txt_sh, (btn_shop.x + (btn_shop.width - txt_sh.get_width()) // 2, btn_shop.y + 14)) elif game_state == "SHOP": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((10, 10, 20, 235)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) title = font_large.render("🛒 CỬA HÀNG TRANG BỊ & NÂNG CẤP", True, GOLD) screen.blit(title, (WIDTH // 2 - title.get_width() // 2, 30)) draw_coin_icon(screen, WIDTH - 75, 25, 12) screen.blit(font.render(f"{player_gold}", True, GOLD), (WIDTH - 55, 15)) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() shop_items = [ {"id": "maxhp", "name": "Tăng Máu Tối Đa", "base_cost": 50}, {"id": "dmg", "name": "Tăng Sát Thương", "base_cost": 70}, {"id": "spd", "name": "Tốc Độ Di Chuyển", "base_cost": 60}, {"id": "multishot", "name": "Pháo Đa Nòng", "base_cost": 120}, {"id": "pierce", "name": "Đạn Xuyên Thấu", "base_cost": 90}, {"id": "rate", "name": "Tốc Độ Bắn Nhanh", "base_cost": 80}, {"id": "vampire", "name": "Trang Bị Hút Máu", "base_cost": 150}, {"id": "explosive", "name": "Đạn Pháo Nổ", "base_cost": 200}, {"id": "nova", "name": "Sóng Nổ Kích Hoạt", "base_cost": 250}, ] col_width, row_height = 420, 50 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - 430, WIDTH // 2 + 10, 90 for i, item in enumerate(shop_items): c = 0 if i < 5 else 1 r = i if c == 0 else i - 5 bx = start_x1 if c == 0 else start_x2 by = start_y + r * row_height if i == 8: bx, by = WIDTH // 2 - col_width // 2, start_y + 5 * row_height rect = pygame.Rect(bx, by, col_width, 44) is_hover = rect.collidepoint(mx, my) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (60, 65, 95) if is_hover else (32, 32, 48), rect, border_radius=10) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GOLD if is_hover else (85, 85, 110), rect, 2, border_radius=10) draw_super_polished_icon(screen, rect.x + 8, rect.y + 1, item["id"], is_hover) lvl = shop_upgrades[item["id"]] screen.blit(font.render(f"{item['name']} [LV {lvl}]", True, WHITE), (rect.x + 58, rect.y + 6)) cost = item["base_cost"] + (lvl * 30) cost_txt = font.render(f"Giá: {cost}", True, GOLD) screen.blit(cost_txt, (rect.x + 58, rect.y + 24)) draw_coin_icon(screen, rect.x + 58 + cost_txt.get_width() + 12, rect.y + 32, 7) btn_back = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 50, 220, 38) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GRAY, btn_back, border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, btn_back, 2, border_radius=8) screen.blit(font.render("QUAY LẠI MENU", True, WHITE), (btn_back.x + 45, btn_back.y + 10)) elif game_state in ["PLAYING", "LEVEL_UP"]: player.draw() for coin in coins: coin.draw() for bullet in bullets: bullet.draw() for zombie in zombies: zombie.draw(player.x, player.y) for exp in explosions: exp.draw() screen.blit(font.render(f"Tank Tier: {player.tier} / 12", True, GOLD), (10, 10)) screen.blit(font.render(f"Cấp: {player.level}", True, WHITE), (10, 30)) screen.blit(font.render(f"Máu: {int(player.hp)} / {int(player.max_hp)}", True, GREEN), (10, 50)) wave_txt = font_medium.render(f"ĐỢT: {current_wave}", True, CYAN) zombies_remaining = (zombies_to_spawn - zombies_spawned_count) + len(zombies) count_txt = font.render(f"Còn lại: {zombies_remaining} con", True, RED) screen.blit(wave_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - wave_txt.get_width() // 2, 10)) screen.blit(count_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - count_txt.get_width() // 2, 34)) draw_coin_icon(screen, WIDTH - 75, 25, 12) screen.blit(font.render(f"{player_gold}", True, GOLD), (WIDTH - 55, 15)) bar_width = WIDTH - 40 bar_height = 10 bar_x, bar_y = 20, HEIGHT - 20 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 22), (bar_x, bar_y, bar_width, bar_height), border_radius=5) current_xp_width = max(0, int(bar_width * (player.exp / player.exp_to_next_level))) if current_xp_width > 0: pygame.draw.rect(screen, BLUE, (bar_x, bar_y, current_xp_width, bar_height), border_radius=5) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (80, 150, 220), (bar_x, bar_y, bar_width, bar_height), 1, border_radius=5) xp_text = font.render(f"XP: {int(player.exp)} / {player.exp_to_next_level}", True, WHITE) screen.blit(xp_text, (WIDTH // 2 - xp_text.get_width() // 2, bar_y - 20)) if game_state == "LEVEL_UP": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((5, 5, 12, 220)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) screen.blit(font_large.render("⚡ NÂNG CẤP KỸ NĂNG XE TĂNG ⚡", True, GOLD), (WIDTH // 2 - 220, 90)) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() for i, choice in enumerate(current_choices): base_rect = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 200, 180 + i * 85, 400, 65) is_hovered = base_rect.collidepoint(mx, my) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (60, 65, 92) if is_hovered else (32, 32, 45), base_rect, border_radius=12) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GOLD if is_hovered else (85, 85, 110), base_rect, 2, border_radius=12) draw_super_polished_icon(screen, base_rect.x + 12, base_rect.y + 11, choice["id"], is_hovered) screen.blit(font.render(choice["text"], True, WHITE), (base_rect.x + 68, base_rect.y + 20)) elif game_state == "GAME_OVER": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((25, 5, 5, 235)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) screen.blit(font_title.render("THẤT BẠI", True, RED), (WIDTH // 2 - 100, HEIGHT // 2 - 100)) btn_restart = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 10, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, RED, btn_restart, border_radius=12) screen.blit(font.render("CHƠI LẠI", True, WHITE), (btn_restart.x + 70, btn_restart.y + 14)) btn_menu = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 70, 220, 48) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GRAY, btn_menu, border_radius=12) screen.blit(font.render("VỀ MENU CHÍNH", True, WHITE), (btn_menu.x + 45, btn_menu.y + 14)) pygame.display.flip() pygame.quit() bỏ tier đi Dưới đây là toàn bộ mã nguồn đã được loại bỏ hoàn toàn hệ thống Tier (Cấp độ xe tăng) theo yêu cầu của bạn. Xe tăng giờ đây sẽ giữ nguyên giao diện chuẩn, không thay đổi theo đợt sóng quái nữa: Python import pygame import random import math pygame.init() # Cấu hình màn hình WIDTH, HEIGHT = 900, 650 screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT)) pygame.display.set_caption("2D Tank vs Zombies") clock = pygame.time.Clock() # Bảng màu sắc đồ họa cao cấp WHITE = (255, 255, 255) BLACK = (10, 10, 15) RED = (255, 60, 60) DARK_RED = (120, 10, 10) GREEN = (45, 240, 120) YELLOW = (255, 230, 60) GRAY = (55, 55, 70) BLUE = (50, 180, 255) ORANGE = (255, 130, 20) CYAN = (0, 245, 245) GOLD = (255, 210, 60) PURPLE = (190, 90, 255) font = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 16, bold=True) font_medium = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 20, bold=True) font_large = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 30, bold=True) font_title = pygame.font.SysFont("Segoe UI", 52, bold=True) player_gold = 500 shop_upgrades = { "maxhp": 0, "dmg": 0, "spd": 0, "multishot": 0, "pierce": 0, "rate": 0, "vampire": 0, "explosive": 0, "nova": 0 } current_wave = 1 zombies_to_spawn = 10 zombies_spawned_count = 0 spawn_timer = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False random.seed(100) BG_DECORATIONS = [] for _ in range(35): BG_DECORATIONS.append({ "type": random.choice(["crater", "rock", "crack", "oil_pool"]), "x": random.randint(50, WIDTH - 50), "y": random.randint(50, HEIGHT - 50), "size": random.randint(20, 55) }) random.seed() def draw_battlefield_background(surface): surface.fill((20, 20, 28)) for deco in BG_DECORATIONS: if deco["type"] == "crater": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (14, 14, 20), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, (28, 28, 38), (deco["x"], deco["y"]), deco["size"], 2) elif deco["type"] == "oil_pool": oil_surf = pygame.Surface((deco["size"]*2, deco["size"]), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(oil_surf, (10, 10, 15, 120), (0, 0, deco["size"]*2, deco["size"])) surface.blit(oil_surf, (deco["x"] - deco["size"], deco["y"] - deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "rock": pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (32, 32, 44), (deco["x"] - deco["size"]//2, deco["y"] - deco["size"]//4, deco["size"], deco["size"]//2)) elif deco["type"] == "crack": pygame.draw.line(surface, (15, 15, 22), (deco["x"] - 12, deco["y"]), (deco["x"] + 18, deco["y"] + 14), 2) def draw_coin_icon(surface, x, y, radius=10): pygame.draw.circle(surface, (180, 120, 10), (x + 1, y + 2), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, GOLD, (x, y), radius) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (x, y), radius - 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (x - 3, y - 3), 2) def draw_super_polished_icon(surface, x, y, skill_id, is_hovered): size = 42 offset = -2 if is_hovered else 0 nx, ny = x + offset, y + offset if is_hovered: glow_surf = pygame.Surface((size + 16, size + 16), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.rect(glow_surf, (255, 215, 0, 120), (0, 0, size + 16, size + 16), border_radius=12) surface.blit(glow_surf, (nx - 8, ny - 8)) pygame.draw.rect(surface, (8, 8, 12), (nx + 2, ny + 4, size, size), border_radius=10) bg_color = (48, 52, 75) if is_hovered else (28, 30, 42) pygame.draw.rect(surface, bg_color, (nx, ny, size, size), border_radius=10) border_col = GOLD if is_hovered else (110, 115, 140) pygame.draw.rect(surface, border_col, (nx, ny, size, size), 2, border_radius=10) cx, cy = nx + size // 2, ny + size // 2 if skill_id == "maxhp": pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (30, 100, 200), [(cx, cy - 14), (cx + 12, cy - 8), (cx + 10, cy + 6), (cx, cy + 14), (cx - 10, cy + 6), (cx - 12, cy - 8)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (80, 170, 255), [(cx, cy - 12), (cx + 10, cy - 7), (cx + 8, cy + 5), (cx, cy + 12), (cx - 8, cy + 5), (cx - 10, cy - 7)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx - 3, cy - 2), 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx + 3, cy - 2), 3) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx - 6, cy - 1), (cx + 6, cy - 1), (cx, cy + 6)]) elif skill_id == "dmg": pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx - 11, cy + 11), (cx + 11, cy - 11), 3) pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx - 10, cy + 10), (cx + 10, cy - 10), 2) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx + 11, cy - 11), (cx + 7, cy - 12), (cx + 12, cy - 7)]) pygame.draw.rect(surface, GOLD, (cx - 11, cy + 7, 5, 5)) elif skill_id == "spd": pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (180, 180, 200), [(cx - 8, cy - 10), (cx + 10, cy - 4), (cx + 10, cy + 4), (cx - 8, cy + 10)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, CYAN, [(cx + 10, cy - 5), (cx + 16, cy), (cx + 10, cy + 5)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, ORANGE, [(cx - 8, cy - 6), (cx - 15, cy), (cx - 8, cy + 6)]) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, YELLOW, [(cx - 8, cy - 3), (cx - 12, cy), (cx - 8, cy + 3)]) elif skill_id == "multishot": for angle in [-20, 0, 20]: rad = math.radians(angle) ex = cx + math.cos(rad) * 12 ey = cy + math.sin(rad) * 12 pygame.draw.line(surface, GRAY, (cx - 6, cy), (ex, ey), 4) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (int(ex + math.cos(rad)*4), int(ey + math.sin(rad)*4)), 3) elif skill_id == "pierce": pygame.draw.rect(surface, (180, 180, 190), (cx - 12, cy - 4, 16, 8), border_radius=2) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx + 4, cy - 6), (cx + 14, cy), (cx + 4, cy + 6)]) pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx - 14, cy), (cx - 10, cy), 3) elif skill_id == "rate": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (40, 180, 100), (cx, cy), 12, 3) pygame.draw.line(surface, WHITE, (cx, cy), (cx + 6, cy - 6), 2) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, YELLOW, [(cx + 4, cy - 10), (cx + 8, cy - 8), (cx + 5, cy - 4)]) elif skill_id == "vampire": pygame.draw.circle(surface, DARK_RED, (cx, cy + 2), 8) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, DARK_RED, [(cx - 8, cy + 2), (cx + 8, cy + 2), (cx, cy - 10)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx, cy + 2), 6) pygame.draw.polygon(surface, RED, [(cx - 6, cy + 2), (cx + 6, cy + 2), (cx, cy - 8)]) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (cx - 2, cy - 1), 2) elif skill_id == "explosive": pygame.draw.circle(surface, (20, 20, 20), (cx - 2, cy + 2), 9) pygame.draw.circle(surface, (60, 60, 65), (cx - 2, cy + 2), 7) pygame.draw.line(surface, GOLD, (cx, cy - 5), (cx + 6, cy - 11), 2) pygame.draw.circle(surface, RED, (cx + 7, cy - 12), 3) pygame.draw.circle(surface, YELLOW, (cx + 7, cy - 12), 1) elif skill_id == "nova": pygame.draw.circle(surface, PURPLE, (cx, cy), 12, 2) pygame.draw.circle(surface, CYAN, (cx, cy), 7, 2) pygame.draw.circle(surface, WHITE, (cx, cy), 3) for i in range(4): ang = i * (math.pi / 2) pygame.draw.line(surface, CYAN, (cx + math.cos(ang)*7, cy + math.sin(ang)*7), (cx + math.cos(ang)*13, cy + math.sin(ang)*13), 2) UPGRADE_POOL = [ {"id": "multishot", "text": "Pháo Đa Nòng (+1 Đạn)"}, {"id": "pierce", "text": "Đạn Xuyên Thấu (+1 Quái)"}, {"id": "explosive", "text": "Đạn Pháo Nổ Diện Rộng"}, {"id": "vampire", "text": "Hút Máu Khi Diệt Quái"}, {"id": "nova", "text": "Sóng Nổ Quét Bản Đồ"}, {"id": "dmg", "text": "+20% Sát Thương Pháo"}, {"id": "spd", "text": "+15% Tốc Độ Động Cơ"}, {"id": "rate", "text": "+20% Tốc Độ Bắn"}, {"id": "maxhp", "text": "+25% Máu Tối Đa"} ] class Coin: def __init__(self, x, y, value): self.x, self.y = x, y self.value = value self.radius = 8 def draw(self): shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((18, 12), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(shadow_surf, (0, 0, 0, 100), (0, 0, 18, 12)) screen.blit(shadow_surf, (int(self.x) - 9, int(self.y) - 3)) draw_coin_icon(screen, int(self.x), int(self.y), self.radius) class Explosion: def __init__(self, x, y, radius): self.x, self.y = x, y self.max_radius = radius self.current_radius = 6 self.alpha = 255 def update(self): self.current_radius += 5 self.alpha -= 18 return self.alpha <= 0 or self.current_radius >= self.max_radius def draw(self): surf = pygame.Surface((self.max_radius * 2, self.max_radius * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA) color = (255, 140, 20, max(0, self.alpha)) core_color = (255, 240, 150, max(0, self.alpha)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius)) pygame.draw.circle(surf, core_color, (self.max_radius, self.max_radius), int(self.current_radius * 0.4)) screen.blit(surf, (self.x - self.max_radius, self.y - self.max_radius)) # LỚP XE TĂNG CHUẨN (KHÔNG CÒN TIER) class TankPlayer: def __init__(self): self.hp = 120 self.reset() def recalculate_stats(self): self.speed = 3.5 + (shop_upgrades["spd"] * 0.4) prev_max_hp = self.max_hp if hasattr(self, 'max_hp') else 120 self.max_hp = 120 + (shop_upgrades["maxhp"] * 30) self.hp += (self.max_hp - prev_max_hp) if hasattr(self, 'hp') else self.max_hp self.damage = 30 + (shop_upgrades["dmg"] * 8) self.fire_rate = max(60, 300 - (shop_upgrades["rate"] * 30)) def reset(self): self.x, self.y = WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2 self.level = 1 self.exp = 0 self.exp_to_next_level = 100 self.last_shot = 0 self.bullet_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["multishot"] self.pierce_count = 1 + shop_upgrades["pierce"] self.explosive_bullets = shop_upgrades["explosive"] > 0 self.vampirism = shop_upgrades["vampire"] * 2 self.recalculate_stats() self.hp = self.max_hp def draw(self): px, py = int(self.x), int(self.y) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() gun_angle = math.atan2(my - py, mx - px) shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((60, 50), pygame.SRCALPHA) pygame.draw.ellipse(shadow_surf, (0, 0, 0, 140), (0, 0, 60, 50)) screen.blit(shadow_surf, (px - 30, py - 18)) # Thiết kế xe tăng tiêu chuẩn duy nhất body_col = (40, 110, 60) track_col = (20, 20, 25) pygame.draw.rect(screen, track_col, (px - 24, py - 20, 10, 40), border_radius=4) pygame.draw.rect(screen, track_col, (px + 14, py - 20, 10, 40), border_radius=4) pygame.draw.rect(screen, body_col, (px - 20, py - 16, 40, 32), border_radius=8) ex_x, ex_y = px + math.cos(gun_angle) * 32, py + math.sin(gun_angle) * 32 pygame.draw.line(screen, (30, 30, 35), (px, py), (ex_x, ex_y), 8) pygame.draw.circle(screen, CYAN, (px, py), 12) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (self.x - 24, self.y - 55, 48, 8), border_radius=3) hp_width = max(0, 44 * (self.hp / self.max_hp)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (self.x - 22, self.y - 53, hp_width, 4), border_radius=2) def move(self, keys): dx, dy = 0, 0 if keys[pygame.K_w] and self.y > 30: dy -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_s] and self.y < HEIGHT - 30: dy += 1 if keys[pygame.K_a] and self.x > 30: dx -= 1 if keys[pygame.K_d] and self.x < WIDTH - 30: dx += 1 if dx != 0 or dy != 0: length = math.hypot(dx, dy) self.x += (dx / length) * self.speed self.y += (dy / length) * self.speed def add_exp(self, amount): self.exp += amount leveled_up = False while self.exp >= self.exp_to_next_level: self.exp -= self.exp_to_next_level self.level += 1 self.exp_to_next_level = self.level * 100 leveled_up = True return leveled_up class Bullet: def __init__(self, x, y, angle_rad, damage, pierce, is_explosive): self.x, self.y = x, y self.damage = damage self.speed = 13 self.dx = math.cos(angle_rad) * self.speed self.dy = math.sin(angle_rad) * self.speed self.pierce = pierce self.is_explosive = is_explosive def update(self): self.x += self.dx self.y += self.dy def draw(self): color = ORANGE if self.is_explosive else YELLOW pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, (int(self.x), int(self.y)), 5) class Zombie: def __init__(self, is_boss=False, wave=1): side = random.choice(['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right']) if side == 'top': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), -45 elif side == 'bottom': self.x, self.y = random.randint(0, WIDTH), HEIGHT + 45 elif side == 'left': self.x, self.y = -45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) else: self.x, self.y = WIDTH + 45, random.randint(0, HEIGHT) self.is_boss = is_boss if is_boss: self.type = "TANK" self.radius, self.speed, self.hp = 28, 1.25, 850 + (wave * 150) self.max_hp = self.hp self.skin_color = (40, 70, 50) self.shirt_color = (30, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 1000, 150 else: self.type = random.choice(["NORMAL", "FAST"]) self.radius = 16 if self.type == "NORMAL" else 13 self.speed = random.uniform(1.3, 1.8) + (wave * 0.05) self.hp = self.max_hp = 50 + (wave - 1) * 20 self.skin_color = (80, 130, 70) if self.type == "NORMAL" else (130, 60, 50) self.shirt_color = (60, 60, 90) if self.type == "NORMAL" else (100, 30, 30) self.exp_reward, self.gold_drop = 15 + (wave * 2), 10 + wave def update(self, px, py): angle = math.atan2(py - self.y, px - self.x) self.x += math.cos(angle) * self.speed self.y += math.sin(angle) * self.speed def draw(self, px, py): ix, iy = int(self.x), int(self.y) angle = math.atan2(py - iy, px - ix) cos_a = math.cos(angle) sin_a = math.sin(angle) shoulder_w = self.radius * 1.1 p1_x = ix + cos_a * 2 - sin_a * shoulder_w p1_y = iy + sin_a * 2 + cos_a * shoulder_w p2_x = ix + cos_a * 2 + sin_a * shoulder_w p2_y = iy + sin_a * 2 - cos_a * shoulder_w pygame.draw.line(screen, self.shirt_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (p2_x, p2_y), int(self.radius * 0.8)) arm_len = self.radius * 1.5 arm1_x = p1_x + cos_a * arm_len arm1_y = p1_y + sin_a * arm_len arm2_x = p2_x + cos_a * arm_len arm2_y = p2_y + sin_a * arm_len pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p1_x, p1_y), (arm1_x, arm1_y), 4) pygame.draw.line(screen, self.skin_color, (p2_x, p2_y), (arm2_x, arm2_y), 4) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm1_x), int(arm1_y)), 3) pygame.draw.circle(screen, DARK_RED, (int(arm2_x), int(arm2_y)), 3) head_x = ix + cos_a * 4 head_y = iy + sin_a * 4 pygame.draw.circle(screen, self.skin_color, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75)) pygame.draw.circle(screen, BLACK, (int(head_x), int(head_y)), int(self.radius * 0.75), 2) eye1_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 - sin_a * 5 eye1_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 + cos_a * 5 eye2_x = head_x + cos_a * 5 + sin_a * 5 eye2_y = head_y + sin_a * 5 - cos_a * 5 pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye1_x), int(eye1_y)), 2) pygame.draw.circle(screen, RED if self.type != "FAST" else YELLOW, (int(eye2_x), int(eye2_y)), 2) if self.hp < self.max_hp: bar_w = self.radius * 2.2 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 20), (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, bar_w, 4)) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, (ix - bar_w / 2, iy - self.radius - 12, max(0, bar_w * (self.hp / self.max_hp)), 4)) def apply_upgrade(player, upgrade_id, zombies, explosions): if upgrade_id == "multishot": player.bullet_count = min(5, player.bullet_count + 1) elif upgrade_id == "pierce": player.pierce_count += 1 elif upgrade_id == "explosive": player.explosive_bullets = True elif upgrade_id == "vampire": player.vampirism += 2 elif upgrade_id == "nova": explosions.append(Explosion(player.x, player.y, 220)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - player.x, z.y - player.y) < 220: z.hp -= 70 elif upgrade_id == "dmg": player.damage *= 1.2 elif upgrade_id == "spd": player.speed *= 1.15 elif upgrade_id == "rate": player.fire_rate = max(60, player.fire_rate * 0.8) elif upgrade_id == "maxhp": player.max_hp *= 1.25 player.hp += player.max_hp * 0.25 player = TankPlayer() bullets, zombies, explosions, coins = [], [], [], [] game_state = "MENU" current_choices = [] def reset_game(): global bullets, zombies, explosions, coins, spawn_timer, game_state, current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave player.reset() bullets.clear(); zombies.clear(); explosions.clear(); coins.clear() current_wave, zombies_to_spawn, zombies_spawned_count, boss_spawned_in_wave = 1, 10, 0, False game_state = "PLAYING" running = True while running: clock.tick(60) current_time = pygame.time.get_ticks() for event in pygame.event.get(): if event.type == pygame.QUIT: running = False if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() if game_state == "MENU": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 20, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 80, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "SHOP" elif game_state == "SHOP": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 55, 220, 40).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" shop_items_data = [ ("maxhp", 50), ("dmg", 70), ("spd", 60), ("multishot", 120), ("pierce", 90), ("rate", 80), ("vampire", 150), ("explosive", 200), ("nova", 250) ] col_width, row_height = 420, 50 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - 430, WIDTH // 2 + 10, 90 for i, (item_id, base_cost) in enumerate(shop_items_data): c = 0 if i < 5 else 1 r = i if c == 0 else i - 5 bx = start_x1 if c == 0 else start_x2 by = start_y + r * row_height if i == 8: bx, by = WIDTH // 2 - col_width // 2, start_y + 5 * row_height if pygame.Rect(bx, by, col_width, 44).collidepoint(mx, my): cost = base_cost + (shop_upgrades[item_id] * 30) if player_gold >= cost: player_gold -= cost shop_upgrades[item_id] += 1 player.reset() elif game_state == "LEVEL_UP": for i in range(len(current_choices)): if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 200, 180 + i * 85, 400, 65).collidepoint(mx, my): apply_upgrade(player, current_choices[i]["id"], zombies, explosions) game_state = "PLAYING" break elif game_state == "GAME_OVER": if pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 10, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): reset_game() elif pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT // 2 + 70, 220, 48).collidepoint(mx, my): game_state = "MENU" keys = pygame.key.get_pressed() if game_state == "PLAYING": player.move(keys) if pygame.mouse.get_pressed()[0] and current_time - player.last_shot > player.fire_rate: mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() base_angle = math.atan2(my - player.y, mx - player.x) spread, num_bullets = 0.15, player.bullet_count start_angle = base_angle - (spread * (num_bullets - 1) / 2) for i in range(num_bullets): bullets.append(Bullet(player.x, player.y, start_angle + (spread * i), player.damage, player.pierce_count, player.explosive_bullets)) player.last_shot = current_time if zombies_spawned_count < zombies_to_spawn: spawn_timer += 1 if spawn_timer >= 30: zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=False, wave=current_wave)) zombies_spawned_count += 1 spawn_timer = 0 elif current_wave % 5 == 0 and not boss_spawned_in_wave: zombies.append(Zombie(is_boss=True, wave=current_wave)) boss_spawned_in_wave = True elif zombies_spawned_count >= zombies_to_spawn and len(zombies) == 0: current_wave += 1 zombies_to_spawn = current_wave * 10 zombies_spawned_count = 0 boss_spawned_in_wave = False for bullet in bullets[:]: bullet.update() if not (0 <= bullet.x <= WIDTH and 0 <= bullet.y <= HEIGHT): bullets.remove(bullet) for exp in explosions[:]: if exp.update(): explosions.remove(exp) for coin in coins[:]: if math.hypot(coin.x - player.x, coin.y - player.y) < 25: player_gold += coin.value coins.remove(coin) for zombie in zombies[:]: zombie.update(player.x, player.y) if math.hypot(zombie.x - player.x, zombie.y - player.y) < zombie.radius + 16: player.hp -= 0.5 if player.hp <= 0: game_state = "GAME_OVER" for bullet in bullets[:]: if math.hypot(zombie.x - bullet.x, zombie.y - bullet.y) < zombie.radius + 4: zombie.hp -= bullet.damage if bullet.is_explosive: explosions.append(Explosion(bullet.x, bullet.y, 85)) for z in zombies: if math.hypot(z.x - bullet.x, z.y - bullet.y) < 85: z.hp -= bullet.damage * 0.5 bullet.pierce -= 1 if bullet.pierce <= 0 and bullet in bullets: bullets.remove(bullet) if zombie.hp <= 0: coins.append(Coin(zombie.x, zombie.y, zombie.gold_drop)) if player.vampirism > 0: player.hp = min(player.max_hp, player.hp + player.vampirism) zombies.remove(zombie) if player.add_exp(zombie.exp_reward): game_state = "LEVEL_UP" current_choices = random.sample(UPGRADE_POOL, 3) break draw_battlefield_background(screen) if game_state == "MENU": overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA) overlay.fill((10, 10, 20, 180)) screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0)) title_txt = font_title.render("TANK VS ZOMBIES", True, GREEN) screen.blit(title_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - title.get_width() // 2, 30)) draw_coin_icon(screen, WIDTH - 75, 25, 12) screen.blit(font.render(f"{player_gold}", True, GOLD), (WIDTH - 55, 15)) mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos() shop_items = [ {"id": "maxhp", "name": "Tăng Máu Tối Đa", "base_cost": 50}, {"id": "dmg", "name": "Tăng Sát Thương", "base_cost": 70}, {"id": "spd", "name": "Tốc Độ Di Chuyển", "base_cost": 60}, {"id": "multishot", "name": "Pháo Đa Nòng", "base_cost": 120}, {"id": "pierce", "name": "Đạn Xuyên Thấu", "base_cost": 90}, {"id": "rate", "name": "Tốc Độ Bắn Nhanh", "base_cost": 80}, {"id": "vampire", "name": "Trang Bị Hút Máu", "base_cost": 150}, {"id": "explosive", "name": "Đạn Pháo Nổ", "base_cost": 200}, {"id": "nova", "name": "Sóng Nổ Kích Hoạt", "base_cost": 250}, ] col_width, row_height = 420, 50 start_x1, start_x2, start_y = WIDTH // 2 - 430, WIDTH // 2 + 10, 90 for i, item in enumerate(shop_items): c = 0 if i < 5 else 1 r = i if c == 0 else i - 5 bx = start_x1 if c == 0 else start_x2 by = start_y + r * row_height if i == 8: bx, by = WIDTH // 2 - col_width // 2, start_y + 5 * row_height rect = pygame.Rect(bx, by, col_width, 44) is_hover = rect.collidepoint(mx, my) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (60, 65, 95) if is_hover else (32, 32, 48), rect, border_radius=10) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GOLD if is_hover else (85, 85, 110), rect, 2, border_radius=10) draw_super_polished_icon(screen, rect.x + 8, rect.y + 1, item["id"], is_hover) lvl = shop_upgrades[item["id"]] screen.blit(font.render(f"{item['name']} [LV {lvl}]", True, WHITE), (rect.x + 58, rect.y + 6)) cost = item["base_cost"] + (lvl * 30) cost_txt = font.render(f"Giá: {cost}", True, GOLD) screen.blit(cost_txt, (rect.x + 58, rect.y + 24)) draw_coin_icon(screen, rect.x + 58 + cost_txt.get_width() + 12, rect.y + 32, 7) btn_back = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 110, HEIGHT - 50, 220, 38) pygame.draw.rect(screen, GRAY, btn_back, border_radius=8) pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, btn_back, 2, border_radius=8) screen.blit(font.render("QUAY LẠI MENU", True, WHITE), (btn_back.x + 45, btn_back.y + 10)) elif game_state in ["PLAYING", "LEVEL_UP"]: player.draw() for coin in coins: coin.draw() for bullet in bullets: bullet.draw() for zombie in zombies: zombie.draw(player.x, player.y) for exp in explosions: exp.draw() screen.blit(font.render(f"Cấp: {player.level}", True, WHITE), (10, 10)) screen.blit(font.render(f"Máu: {int(player.hp)} / {int(player.max_hp)}", True, GREEN), (10, 30)) wave_txt = font_medium.render(f"ĐỢT: {current_wave}", True, CYAN) zombies_remaining = (zombies_to_spawn - zombies_spawned_count) + len(zombies) count_txt = font.render(f"Còn lại: {zombies_remaining} con", True, RED) screen.blit(wave_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - wave_txt.get_width() // 2, 10)) screen.blit(count_txt, (WIDTH // 2 - count_txt.get_width() // 2, 34)) draw_coin_icon(screen, WIDTH - 75, 25, 12) screen.blit(font.render(f"{player_gold}", True, GOLD), (WIDTH - 55, 15)) bar_width = WIDTH - 40 bar_height = 10 bar_x, bar_y = 20, HEIGHT - 20 pygame.draw.rect(screen, (15, 15, 22), (bar_x, bar_y, bar_width, bar_height), border_radius=5) current_xp_width = max(0, int(bar_width * (player.exp / player.exp_to_next_level))) if current_xp_width > 0: pygame.draw.rect(screen, BLUE, (bar_x, bar_y, current_xp_width, bar_height), border_radius=5) pygame.draw.rect(screen, (80, 150, 220), (bar_x, bar_y, bar_width, bar_height), 1, border_radius=5) xp_text = font.render(f"XP: {int(player.exp)} / {player.exp_to_next_level}", True, WHITE) screen.blit(xp_text, (WIDTH // 2 -
